title: Head of SEO & AI Search (all genders)
description: Über uns Wir begeistern und inspirieren Millionen von Menschen! Als innovativer Hybrid aus Social Media Publisher und Social Media Agentur vereint das VS Mediahouse einzigartige Expertise in den Bereichen Content-Kreation, Markenaufbau und Performance-Marketing. Mit einem Team von über 50 Experten in Social Media, Design und Videoproduktion betreiben wir die beliebtesten Social-Media-Marken Deutschlands auf Facebook, Instagram und TikTok. Zu unseren Erfolgsmarken zählen unter anderem VS, Lieblingskollegen und Lieblingsmensch®. Unser tiefes Verständnis für die Dynamik von Social Media und unser Publishing-Know-how ermöglichen es uns, Marken wie Samsung, Schwartau, Bayer und Lexware im Bereich Social Media nachhaltig erfolgreich zu machen. Wir schaffen Verbindungen, erzählen Geschichten und setzen Trends – für echte Wirkung und messbaren Erfolg. Deine Mission Du beherrschst klassisches SEO in der Tiefe, mit mehrjähriger Senior-Erfahrung. Gleichzeitig ist dir klar: Kaum noch jemand sucht heute komplett ohne KI, sei es über ChatGPT, Gemini oder AI Overviews. Diesen Wandel willst du nicht nur beobachten, sondern aktiv gestalten. Klar ist dabei: Ohne solides SEO-Fundament funktioniert auch die beste GEO-Strategie nicht, deshalb bringst du beides mit. Als Head of SEO & AI Search verantwortest du unseren SEO-Bereich strategisch, operativ und wirtschaftlich. Im Zentrum deiner Rolle stehen von Beginn an unsere größten und strategisch wichtigsten Bestandskunden: Hier baust du die SEO- und AI-Search-Strategie neu und mit voller Verantwortung auf Senior-Ebene auf, im direkten Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung des Kunden. Perspektivisch entwickelst du von dort aus den SEO-Bereich für weitere Kunden im Haus. KI spielt dabei eine doppelte Rolle: erstens als Zielsystem, du machst Kunden auch in KI-gestützten Suchsystemen sichtbar. Zweitens als Arbeitsweise, du nutzt KI selbst für Recherche, Analysen, Briefings und Reporting. Ein fertiges Technik-Portfolio brauchst du dafür nicht, wichtiger sind echte Neugier und Lust, dich reinzuhängen. Bei uns wirst du zum KI-Poweruser deines Fachbereichs. Was erwartet dich AI Search & Sichtbarkeit – der Kern der Rolle, kein Nebenschauplatz: Du entwickelst Strategien, damit Inhalte in Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Gemini und Perplexity auffindbar, verständlich und zitierfähig sind. Du denkst Inhalte für generative Systeme mit: klar beantwortbare Absätze, saubere Q&A-Strukturen, belastbares Schema-Markup, damit KI-Systeme Inhalte einordnen und zitieren können. Sichtbarkeit messbar machen: Du entwickelst Testsets und Prompt-Sammlungen, um systematisch zu beobachten, wann und wie Marken, Produkte und Inhalte in KI-Antworten genannt werden – idealerweise mit AI-Visibility-Tools wie Peec, Otterly oder Profound. Einordnung statt Hype: Du ordnest GEO und AEO fachlich ein, statt Hype hinterherzulaufen, und vermittelst ehrlich, wo es heute schon belastbare Ergebnisse gibt und wo noch nicht. Dein Case: Verantwortung von Tag eins. Du übernimmst die strategische, operative und wirtschaftliche Führung des SEO- und AI-Search-Mandats für einen unserer wichtigsten Kunden, von der Analyse bis zur Erfolgskontrolle. Du baust eine SEO- und GEO-Roadmap auf, die es in dieser Form bislang nicht gab, und verantwortest ihre Umsetzung. Beratung auf Augenhöhe: Du berätst die Geschäftsführung des Kunden souverän in Workshops, Audits und Reviews. Dein Alltag: KI als deine tägliche Arbeitsweise Hier geht es nicht um die Arbeit für Kunden, sondern um deinen eigenen Alltag: Viele wiederkehrende Aufgaben erledigst du bei uns spürbar schneller, weil du KI dafür einsetzt – kein Kür-Thema, sondern Standard. Zum Beispiel: Keyword-Clustering und Content-Gap-Analysen per KI vorbereiten, statt sie komplett von Hand zu erstellen. Erste Content-Briefings und Gliederungsentwürfe mit KI entwerfen. Crawl- und Search-Console-Daten von KI vorauswerten, bevor du selbst tief einsteigst. Wiederkehrende Reports automatisieren, statt sie jede Woche neu zusammenzuklicken. Die Qualitätskontrolle bleibt trotzdem bei dir: KI-Ergebnisse werden von dir eingeordnet und geprüft, nicht blind übernommen. Was solltest du mitbringen Bei SEO erwarten wir echte Tiefe. Bei KI muss es kein Fachwissen oder Abschluss sein, aber komplett bei null solltest du auch nicht stehen. Die technischen Hürden legen wir bewusst niedrig, ein bisschen eigene Praxis braucht es trotzdem. Mehrjährige SEO- und AI-Search-Erfahrung aus Agentur- oder vergleichbarer Unternehmensumgebung, mit nachweisbaren Ergebnissen. Ein bestimmter Studienabschluss ist für uns nicht entscheidend, wichtiger sind Tiefgang, Ergebnisse und Neugier. Tiefgehende Kenntnisse in Technical SEO, Content SEO, Onpage- und Offpage-Optimierung. Erfahrung mit ganzheitlichen SEO-Strategien und Roadmaps, die du für unterschiedliche Kunden von der Analyse bis zur Erfolgskontrolle steuerst – inklusive technischer Audits (Crawling, Indexierung, Core Web Vitals, strukturierte Daten), Relaunches und Migrationen. Keyword-, Content- und Autoritätsstrategien, die echten Mehrwert statt reiner Keyword-Abdeckung liefern. Sicherer Umgang mit Google Search Console, GA4, Sistrix, Semrush oder Ahrefs sowie Screaming Frog oder Sitebulb. Ein Bewusstsein für den Wandel zu KI-gestützter Suche: GEO, AEO oder AI Visibility sind dir zumindest ein Begriff, und du willst dich darin vertiefen. Du hast bereits eigene Erfahrung mit KI-Tools gesammelt, und sei es nur privat (Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity & Co.). Ein Zertifikat oder eine Ausbildung brauchst du dafür nicht, wichtiger ist Lust, das jetzt systematisch für deine SEO-Arbeit einzusetzen. Denken in Leads, Conversions und Kundennutzen statt nur in Rankings, dazu eine eigenständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und sicheres Englisch. Warum VS Mediahouse Wir sind auf der Suche nach motivierten Mitarbeitenden, die etwas bewegen möchten, Mut für neue Ideen haben und das Unternehmen aktiv mitgestalten wollen. Wir legen großen Wert auf einen respektvollen Umgang auf Augenhöhe. Neben unseren modernen Büros im Herzen von Freiburg erwarten dich ausgezeichnete Arbeitsbedingungen in einem hoch dynamischen und wachstumsstarken Umfeld. Freue dich auf vielseitige Aufgaben mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und unternehmerischem Gestaltungsspielraum sowie eine moderne, sachorientierte Entscheidungskultur ohne unnötige Hierarchien. Wir bieten dir fachliche und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch Freiraum für Innovationen, kurze Entscheidungswege und individuelles Management-Coaching. Das bieten wir dir Wähle zwischen einem kostenfreien Jobticket (Deutschlandticket) oder nutze unser attraktives JobRad-Angebot. Um dich fit und gesund zu halten, subventionieren wir deine Hansefit-Mitgliedschaft. Du findest bei uns modernste Ausstattung mit höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen sowie Macbook & iPhone (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und natürlich ist das Arbeiten aus dem Homeoffice auch für uns kein Fremdwort. Für Zwischendurch bedienst du dich an unserem regionalen Obst, Müsli, Kaffee, Getränke und vieles mehr. Neben deinem persönlichen Corporate Benefits Zugang erhältst du 50% Rabatt auf unsere Produkte in unserem Shop. Erweitere deine Rente durch die Teilnahme an der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge. Abgerundet wird deine Zeit bei uns natürlich auch mit verschiedenen Team-Events und Feiern. Klingt nach dir? Wir suchen niemanden, der nur Rankings reportet, und genauso wenig einen reinen KI-Enthusiasten ohne SEO-Substanz. Sondern jemanden, der SEO in der Tiefe beherrscht, Lust hat, KI in den eigenen Arbeitsalltag zu integrieren, und bereit ist, für einen unserer wichtigsten Kunden von Anfang an echte Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Technisches KI-Vorwissen ist zweitrangig, echte Motivation nicht. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Beschreibe uns stattdessen kurz zwei bis drei SEO-Projekte, für die du verantwortlich warst (Ausgangslage, deine Rolle, Ergebnis), und beantworte: 1. Wie nutzt du KI heute schon in deinem Alltag, und was reizt dich daran, KI-gestützte Suche zum Kernteil deiner Arbeit zu machen? 2. Wo hast du KI schon sinnvoll in einem SEO-Prozess eingesetzt? Falls noch nicht: Was würdest du als Erstes ausprobieren? 3. Wie misst du SEO-Erfolg, wenn Rankings und Klicks allein nicht mehr reichen? Wenn du mehr über unsere Arbeitskultur und das Arbeitsumfeld erfahren möchtest, laden wir dich ein, die Bewertungen unserer Mitarbeiter auf Kununu zu lesen. Dort findest du ehrliche Meinungen und Feedback von aktuellen und ehemaligen Mitarbeitern. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Wir glauben an das Potential unserer Mitarbeiter:innen. Wir sind Pioniere und haben neue Technologien entwickelt. Wir sind neugierig, leben eine offene Fehlerkultur und teilen unser Wissen. Wir setzen innovative Geschäftsmodelle nachhaltig um. Aufgaben Job Results - Tätigkeiten Generierung und Qualifizierung von Leads zur Sicherung attraktiver Flächen für Charge Farms, Energieparks und Batteriespeicherprojekte. Identifikation und Bewertung neuer Projektpotenziale im Bereich Photovoltaik, Batteriespeicher und Ladeinfrastruktur. Aufbau eines belastbaren Netzwerks aus Flächeneigentümern, Kommunen, Unternehmen und Projektpartnern zur langfristigen Sicherung neuer Projektmöglichkeiten. title: Senior Data Science Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><p>Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do.</p> <p>Our EMEA Data Science organisation sits at the heart of Deliveroo and Wolt, powering decision-making across product, commercial and operational teams through experimentation, causal inference and deep business understanding. As part of DoorDash, our EMEA Data Science team brings together colleagues across Deliveroo and Wolt, creating opportunities to learn from different markets and tackle complex local-commerce challenges.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Senior Data Science Manager to shape data science strategy across a broad area of our Logistics organisation. You’ll combine strong people leadership, technical judgement and commercial thinking to help our teams make better decisions and deliver measurable business impact.</p> <h2><strong>About The Logistics Team</strong></h2> <p>Logistics makes our marketplace work in the real world: connecting riders with orders and helping deliveries happen efficiently and reliably. The organisation works on problems such as predicting demand, improving delivery-time estimates, and matching orders with riders, all in an efficient way to ensure we can offer the most affordable pricing to our customers.</p> <p>These are interconnected challenges. Decisions about supply, incentives and network efficiency can affect consumers, riders and restaurant and retail partners at the same time. Data Science helps us understand those relationships, test new approaches and balance delivery reliability, rider experience and sustainable business economics.</p> <p>It’s an environment where rigorous experimentation meets real-world complexity, and where your team’s work can shape both everyday operational decisions and longer-term product strategy.</p> <h2><strong>What You’ll Be Doing&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>You’ll own the data science direction and measurable impact of a broad Logistics problem space spanning multiple cross-functional teams. You’ll:</p> <ul> <li>Set strategy and priorities with Product, Engineering and Operations leaders, focusing investment on the highest-impact opportunities across immediate needs and longer-term goals.</li> <li>Build and develop a high-performing, inclusive team through hiring, coaching and performance management, growing leaders who can deliver independently.</li> <li>Guide solutions to complex marketplace challenges, from balancing supply and demand to evaluating incentives and improving delivery performance and economics.</li> <li>Set the technical bar for experimentation, causal inference and analysis, staying close enough to challenge approaches and ensure decisions reflect real marketplace effects.</li> <li>Influence senior stakeholders and align teams around shared outcomes, resolving competing priorities and turning evidence into product and operational decisions.</li> <li>Directly lead projects that resolve highly complex challenges, which often span across multiple parts of the business and unlock new vectors of impact, boosting company-level goals.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You’ll Need to Thrive</strong></h2> <p>Our ideal candidate will bring:</p> <ul> <li>A track record of leading and developing high-performing data science or closely related analytical teams, with responsibility for complex work spanning multiple teams or business areas.</li> <li>Experience setting analytical strategy and allocating people and effort across competing priorities, with clear evidence of product, operational or commercial impact.</li> <li>Strong technical foundations in experimentation, causal inference and statistical analysis, with the judgement to select appropriate methods, challenge conclusions and coach experienced practitioners.</li> <li>The ability to reason about interconnected systems and trade-offs, including how an intervention in one part of a marketplace can affect outcomes elsewhere.</li> <li>Experience influencing senior cross-functional leaders, aligning teams around shared goals and turning complex evidence into clear, actionable recommendations.</li> <li>A thoughtful approach to building teams: hiring, coaching, managing performance and developing future technical and people leaders.</li> <li>Comfort creating structure in ambiguous environments, making pragmatic decisions with incomplete information and adapting as new evidence emerges.</li> </ul> <p>Experience developing other people managers would be particularly valuable. Experience in marketplaces, logistics, mobility, pricing, incentives or other operationally complex businesses is helpful, but not essential. We also value leaders who can bring relevant approaches from other domains.</p> <p>You don’t need to have worked on every problem listed here. We’re interested in the depth of your leadership, the quality of your judgement and the impact you enable through others.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Diversity, Equity and Inclusion</strong><br><br>At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.</p> <p>We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.</p> <p>If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.</p> <p>If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><em data-renderer-mark="true"><br>Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at</em> <a class="_ymio1r31 _ypr0glyw _zcxs1o36 _mizu194a _1ah3dkaa _ra3xnqa1 _128mdkaa _1cvmnqa1 _4davt94y _4bfu18uv _1hms8stv _ajmmnqa1 _vchhusvi _kqswh2mm _2rkolb4i _ect4ttxp _syaz13af _1a3b18uv _4fpr8stv _5goinqa1 _f8pj13af _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _30l313af _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _9h8h12zz _10531ra0 _1ien1ra0 _n0fx1ra0 _1vhv17z1" href="http://careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness" data-renderer-mark="true" data-is-router-link="false" data-testid="link-with-safety"><em data-renderer-mark="true">careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness</em></a><em data-renderer-mark="true">.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

You are proficient in applying Incident Response frameworks (NIST IR Lifecycle, Cyber Kill Chain, MITRE ATT&amp;CK) to real-world scenarios, and you collaborate effectively with engineering colleagues, leveraging extensive expertise across infrastructure and technologies (Public Cloud, OS, Virtualization, Containerization, Networking, Build/Development infrastructure, and Hardware).</li> <li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field; advanced degree preferred or equivalent experience.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You are:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>A Builder-Operator:</strong> You would rather automate a problem out of existence than staff around it and you hold yourself to an engineering bar even under incident pressure.</li> <li><strong>A Strategic Self-Starter:</strong> You don't wait for instructions. 🛠️ About our Fleet Operations Team

 

As the Fleet Operations Training Lead, UK, you will lead the development, delivery, and continuous improvement of training across our Fleet Operations teams. You will ensure that team members have the knowledge, practical skills, and confidence required to operate safely, consistently, and effectively.

You will establish consistent training standards across both regions while adapting programs to reflect local operational, cultural, language, and regulatory requirements.

 

We’re looking for someone who is organised, collaborative, and passionate about developing others: a pragmatic leader who is comfortable working in a fast-moving, safety-focused environment and can balance immediate training needs with a longer-term strategy. As our Fleet Operations function grows, you will develop scalable training programs and processes that can support additional geographies in the future.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

 

  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive training strategy and roadmap for Fleet Operations in the UK, aligned with organisational priorities, operational requirements, and future geographical expansion

  • Design, implement, and regularly update onboarding, technical, safety, compliance, and professional-development programs for Fleet Operations teams

  • Partner with Fleet Operations leaders and subject-matter experts to assess skills, identify capability gaps, and prioritise training requirements

  • Deliver engaging instructor-led, virtual, practical, and blended learning experiences for employees with different levels of experience and technical knowledge

  • Establish consistent training and competency standards while adapting content and delivery to local languages, cultures, regulations, and operational environments

  • Create structured learning paths, practical assessments, competency frameworks, and certification programs that ensure employees are prepared to perform their roles safely and effectively

  • Define and monitor measures such as participation, knowledge retention, practical proficiency, time to competency, learner feedback, and operational performance

  • Use performance data, employee feedback, incident trends, and operational insights to continually improve training content, methods, and outcomes

  • Develop and manage train-the-trainer programs, supporting local trainers and Fleet Operations leaders to deliver learning consistently and effectively

  • Use learning technologies to make training accessible, scalable, and engaging, while maintaining accurate records of training, competency, and certification

  • Work closely with Fleet Operations, Safety, Engineering, People, and other stakeholders to ensure training reflects current technology, processes, risks, and business priorities

  • Support the introduction of new technologies, vehicles, processes, policies, and programmes through structured training and change-readiness activities

  • Champion continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and professional development across Fleet Operations

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

 

  • Developing and delivering onboarding, technical, safety, and professional-development training

  • Building and maintaining competency frameworks, learning paths, and certification programs

  • Collaborating cross-functionally to ensure training keeps pace with operational and technological change

  • Evaluating training effectiveness using participation, performance, and feedback metrics

  • Running train-the-trainer initiatives and supporting local training delivery

  • Continuously iterating on training content, standards, and processes, making improvements based on data and feedback

  • Supporting operational change by creating learning experiences for new tools, vehicles, and systems

 

🙌 You should apply if

 

  • You have a strong track record of developing and implementing comprehensive operational training programs, including training-needs analysis, instructional design, delivery, and evaluation

  • You have demonstrated leadership experience within a high-velocity, safety-focused fleet, operational, or technical environment

  • You have experience supporting training across multiple locations, regions, or culturally diverse teams

  • You have excellent facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to make complex technical and operational information clear and accessible

  • You have experience creating structured learning paths, practical assessments, competency frameworks, and certification programs

  • You have strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify capability gaps and evaluate the effectiveness and operational impact of training

  • You possess strong stakeholder-management skills and can collaborate with Fleet Operations, Safety, Engineering, People, and subject-matter experts

  • You have excellent time-management and prioritisation skills, with proven ability to respond effectively to changing requirements in a fast-paced environment

  • You are able to work effectively across Europe and travel between operational locations when required

  • You are available to work on-site five days a week

  • You have a clean and compliant driving record in accordance with company requirements

  • You have a safety-conscious mindset, with the confidence to identify and escalate potential risks

 

Desirable

 

  • Experience establishing or scaling training programs across multiple countries or geographical regions

  • Experience adapting training for different languages, cultures, regulatory requirements, and operational contexts

  • Familiarity with learning-management systems, digital learning tools, and virtual or blended learning approaches

  • Experience developing train-the-trainer programs or leading a distributed network of trainers

  • Familiarity with advanced driver-assistance systems, including sensors and onboard hardware and firmware

  • Experience in fleet operations, particularly data collection and closed-loop testing of ADAS functions

  • Experience working within the automotive, autonomous-vehicle, robotics, AI, mobility, or another safety-critical industry

  • Japanese-language capability or previous experience working closely with teams in Japan

  • Experience working in a fast-moving technology company or startup

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

 

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

 

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

 

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

 

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

 

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews (Team Fit & Stakeholder Management; 2 hours total)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Training, Quality Assurance, and Fleet Operations; 3 hours total)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment (1 hour)

 

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependent):

 

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

🛠️ About our AI Platform Team

Our AI Platform teams build the foundations that enable Wayve’s machine learning engineers and researchers to train, evaluate and deploy models at scale. Within the AI Libraries team, you’ll create high-quality platforms, tools and reusable abstractions that support thousands of GPUs and help accelerate the development of our autonomous-driving technology.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

You’ll work closely with machine learning teams to understand their workflows and turn complex requirements into stable, scalable and intuitive software. You’ll spend much of your time designing and writing Python, leading projects from discovery through delivery, improving engineering standards and supporting users as they push the scale and performance of their models.

🧩 What you’ll be working on

You’ll build modular libraries for areas such as multimodal data loading, distributed training and inference, checkpointing and observability. You’ll improve the reliability, performance and developer experience of systems used across Wayve, helping teams train models efficiently on large GPU clusters and work with camera, radar, lidar and other data sources.

 

🙌 You should apply if

You have deep Python expertise and a proven track record of leading the design, delivery and long-term evolution of high-quality software systems at scale. You can turn complex requirements across ML teams into stable, reusable libraries and clear APIs, set technical direction, and raise the bar for software architecture, testing and observability. You remain hands-on while guiding other engineers and driving projects end to end, from shaping requirements through to adoption and maintenance. Experience with concurrent, parallel or distributed computing is important; familiarity with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow and cloud environments—ideally Azure—is highly valuable. This is a Staff-level software and platform engineering role, not an ML modelling position.

The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. Role Overview

Airwallex is seeking highly skilled Sanctions Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our second line of defense (2LoD) Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) team. To support our global operations and ensure nuanced, localized oversight, we are looking for dedicated, in-region sanctions specialists across EMEA/UK.

In this role, you will act as the ultimate regional escalation point for L3 sanctions alerts to advise on complicated sanctions matches, drive sanctions investigations and efficacy of sanctions screening, determine potential reporting obligations, and assist in scaling a global sanctions program.   • Own L3 Sanctions case investigation and decisioning regionally, assessing applicable reporting, disclosure, and recordkeeping obligations.

  • Provide practical, timely, and risk-based sanctions advice on complex cross-border payment flows, indirect exposure, jurisdictional conflicts, new products and services, customer segments, commercial transactions, and geographic expansion.

  • Own and maintain regional Sanctions operational procedures and provide effective second-line oversight of sanctions controls implemented by first-line teams, ensuring alignment with the Global Sanctions Policy while incorporating applicable local requirements.

  • Liaise with global teams to provide actionable feedback on product-specific controls and screening technologies, leveraging in-region expertise and historical L3 escalations to ensure continuous optimization and alignment with the organization’s risk appetite.

  • Monitor US, regional, and international sanctions and export-control developments, geopolitical events, and regulatory expectations, assessing their impact on customers, products, jurisdictions, lists, systems, procedures, and risk appetite.

  • Develop and deliver targeted training and ongoing guidance for L2 sanctions reviewers, KYC, Operations, and other stakeholders on sanctions risk, alert adjudication, investigative research, discounting criteria, escalation standards, and documentation requirements.

  • Lead responses to banking partners and other external stakeholders on sanctions-related inquiries and due diligence reviews.

Qualifications

  • 7-10 years of relevant experience, preferably at a fintech, payments company, or large financial institution specializing in sanctions.

  • Experience managing sanctions alerts at the L3 level, recommending blocking/freezing transactions, assessing sanctions-related licenses and respective transactional permissibility, and managing reporting.

  • History of assessing current sanctions frameworks and recommending enhancements to strengthen the program, including designing and scaling sanctions programs.

  • Demonstrated understanding of in-region sanctions regulations and industry best practices pertaining to economic sanctions; knowledge of US sanctions in addition to in-region expertise is strongly preferred.

  • History of executing the operationalization of sanctions controls in collaboration with technological teams, adhering to global policies, in-region procedures, and risk appetite.

  • A history of interacting or supporting engagement with external stakeholders such as regulators or financial institution partners on sanctions matters.

  • Expert knowledge of financial and trade sanctions within the European Union (EU) framework and UK regulations administered by the Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation (OFSI) and corresponding export control bodies.

raw.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

Enterprise finance teams rarely choose a spend platform alone. ERP vendors, consultancies, procurement and T&E platforms, and technology partners are usually involved. You'll build and run the partnerships that put Airwallex in front of those buyers, turning them into a repeatable source of pipeline and revenue across Europe. This is a hands-on commercial role with a number to hit.

  • Define the EMEA partnership strategy, joint business plans, and KPIs, including partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, revenue, and activation.

  • Source, negotiate, and close partners across consultancies and GSIs, ERP and procurement ecosystems, technology partners, and private equity firms.

  • Enable partner sales teams to position Airwallex with confidence, and work with Enterprise AEs to bring partners into live deals early.

  • Run regular business reviews with priority partners, and own commercial terms, amendments, and renewals with Legal.

  • Plan joint events and campaigns with Partner Marketing.

  • Feed partner and customer insight to Product, and document what works in repeatable playbooks.

You'll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 6+ years in partnerships, alliances, channel, or business development, ideally in SaaS or fintech.

  • A quota-carrying background, with a track record of closing enterprise deals or revenue-generating partnerships.

  • Experience selling to or through Finance, Procurement, or IT leaders, including CFOs, FDs, and Heads of Procurement.

  • A network in at least one of consultancies, ERP or T&E ecosystems, or private equity.

  • Confidence structuring and negotiating commercial agreements, and influencing senior stakeholders.

  • An ownership mindset: comfortable building from a blank page and measuring the result.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with spend management, corporate cards, AP automation, or cross-border payments.

  • Experience with marketplace or integration-led partner programmes.

  • Additional European languages.

You'll thrive here if

  • You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you're motivated by stretch goals.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You know when to align and when to just decide. Collaboration isn't a way to avoid accountability.

Learn more about your team

Financial & Strategic Partnerships builds the relationships that expand what our platform can do and where it can go next. This team structures deals with financial institutions, fintech platforms, and enterprise software companies that embed Airwallex's infrastructure into their own products: commercially complex work that accelerates growth, opens new markets, and extends distribution reach.

It's a function for strategic thinkers and dealmakers who think in systems, with range across commercial negotiation, technical scoping, and cross-functional coordination. The work is open-ended by nature, and the best outcomes come from people who thrive without an inherited playbook.

If you want to identify, define, and negotiate consequential commercial relationships at the frontier of global finance, this team does the kind of work that will challenge and motivate you.

raw.title: Content & Growth Marketer
raw.description:
About Tradeaze

Tradeaze is on-demand delivery for the built environment. Builders' merchants book a delivery in our app, and a vetted driver collects from the branch and delivers to site the same day. We work with national groups like Jewson, Travis Perkins, EH Smith and Lords, and we are growing fast. You would be the second person in growth and marketing, joining as the new brand and website go live.

The role

You are a content-leaning generalist marketer who uses AI to do the work of a bigger team. Your job is to bring new branches onto Tradeaze and turn them into regular customers. You make the message; we run the system behind it.

What you will do

  • Make content for two audiences: the people who use Tradeaze every day (branch staff and drivers), and the people who follow us on LinkedIn as a tech-forward start-up. Posts, short video, case studies, printed pieces, content from around the office
  • Turn one real delivery into three things in a week: a case study, a post and a one-pager sales can carry into a branch
  • Write the campaigns that turn a new branch into a regular customer, from the idea to the words to the design
  • Sit with the marketing team at a merchant head office and run a joint campaign across their branches
  • Keep socials and the blog moving, with AI doing the first draft and you deciding what's good
  • Be out at yards and branches with a camera, and at trade events with a stand

Who you are

  • Around 3 years in marketing, in a small team or start-up where you made the work yourself. Less is fine if your work shows it
  • You take ownership. You spot what needs doing and do it without being asked, and you treat the results as yours.
  • You've designed things people actually used: a post, a flyer, a deck. Use whatever tool you like (Figma, Adobe), as long as the work looks professional
  • You write for an audience, whether you write it yourself or set the lines and guidelines and have AI draft it. Either way you know what a counter manager will read and what a LinkedIn follower will stop for
  • You already use AI in your work. You can show us something you shipped with it and talk us through how you use it
  • You've taken a campaign from the idea to launch: the message, the words and the design
  • You come to a conversation with ideas and you enjoy bouncing them off someone
  • You're personable: comfortable with sales reps, a room full of branch managers, and sitting with a merchant head office's marketing team to run a joint campaign
  • You'd rather get it live this week and improve it than plan it for a month
  • Nice to have: paid ads (you've run paid social or search with a budget), events (you've helped run a trade show stand) and email copy (you've written emails that get people to take one clear action)

Not for you if:

  • You want a brief handed to you
  • You need an agency to make things
  • You'd rather plan than ship

How we work

You will report to our GTM Engineer, and you both report to Jack, our CEO. You will work with the GTM Engineer day to day. They own the systems: the CRM, the email platform, the data and the sends. You own the message and the content. You will plan together, brainstorm together, and look at the numbers together every Monday. Jack opens the door with merchant head offices; you and the GTM Engineer run what happens next.

You will see your work on a live dashboard: what shipped, what it reached, and which branches ordered because of it.

What you get

  • £40k to £48k
  • Stock options
  • 25 days holiday
  • A laptop

How to apply

With your application, send us:

  1. 3 to 5 pieces of content you made yourself, ideally including one video you filmed and cut yourself (a phone is fine). Other examples: a social post or carousel, a campaign from idea to launch, a printed piece, a case study. For each one, a line on what you did and what it led to
  2. A few lines on how you use AI: which tools, for what, and one thing it let you ship

How we will hire

  1. Send us 3 to 5 pieces you made and a few lines on how you work with AI
  2. A call with Jack, our CEO
  3. A short campaign task, then a call with our GTM Engineer to talk it through
  4. Present your idea to the team in person: the same idea, updated with what you'd change. 15 minutes, no new deck needed

unique in our approach. We design, build, and&nbsp;</span><span data-ccp-parastyle="FIR Body">operate</span><span data-ccp-parastyle="FIR Body"> a new class of digital </span></span><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="FIR Body">infrastructure – the AI Factory. The function builds the guarded automation, remediation and operational tooling that turn manual response into a software-defined capability, and builds and operates the shared services the estate's own operation depends on. The function works closely with the engineering teams that build the platform, supplying the production evidence that shapes what they fix and what they build next.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="Body Text">Role Summary</span></span> </strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;134245417&quot;:true,&quot;335557856&quot;:16777215,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>Firmus runs large-scale, state-of-the-art AI infrastructure built on the latest generation of GPU rack-scale systems and operated as one estate to power the next generation of AI innovation. The Platform Reliability Engineer is part of the team that operates the platform services Firmus AI Cloud runs on in production: the GPU compute fleet, exabyte-scale storage, the multi-tenant control and management plane, and the virtualisation and shared services that host it.&nbsp;Together, these are the foundation every customer workload depends on.</p> <p>This is a hands-on site reliability engineering role that works across the stack, from Linux and Kubernetes to storage, virtualisation and the compute fleet. The team runs each service to a declared service level, measures reliability against it, and treats operations as a software problem, engineering repetitive manual work out of the system rather than absorbing it. The role picks up incidents escalated from first response, owns each one through to resolution, and works across teams and vendors to restore service, bringing in specialist engineers when a fault needs deeper investigation. Automation is a first-class part of the role: faults are diagnosed using the observability stack, post-incident reviews feed fixes back into the platform, and every resolved fault is a candidate for a runbook or an automated fix.</p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:17,&quot;335559740&quot;:259}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="Body Text">Key Responsibilities</span></span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Triage, diagnose and resolve incidents across the stack, including Kubernetes clusters and workloads, storage, virtualisation, network connectivity and the underlying Linux hosts, owning each incident from escalation through to resolution.</li> <li>Operate the multi-tenant control and management plane that Firmus' AI and infrastructure services depend on, including the tenancy, quota and access controls that support separation between tenant workloads and&nbsp;data.</li> <li>Operate the virtualisation platform that hosts the management plane, and the shared services that run on it, to their declared service levels.</li> <li>Operate Firmus' exabyte-scale distributed and high-performance filesystems and S3-compatible object storage to their declared service levels, handling capacity, performance and availability incidents and&nbsp;escalating to specialist engineers and vendors (for example VAST or WEKA) with clear evidence when further investigation is needed.</li> <li>Operate the GPU compute fleet in production: node health and readiness, GPU and node fault detection and handling, firmware and driver currency to the supported baselines, remediation and return to service, and support for cluster provisioning and validation activities.</li> <li>Reduce toil by converting repeat fixes into runbooks and automated remediation delivered as controlled code, contributing to the team's automation and remediation tooling.</li> <li>Diagnose performance problems across the data path between compute and storage, gathering the evidence needed to resolve them and working with network and storage specialists where required.</li> <li>Deliver change as code through the agreed change process, with peer review, testing, staged rollout where applicable, and a rollback plan.</li> <li>Use the observability stack (for example Grafana, Prometheus, Loki and Tempo) to track service level indicators against their objectives, query metrics, logs and traces, correlate signals across services and diagnose faults, and improve dashboards and alerting so that each alert is actionable and tied to a runbook.</li> <li>Execute the patching cycle and urgent vulnerability remediation across the services the team operates.</li> <li>Manage vendor support cases across the hardware and software portfolio, raising and tracking cases under the relevant support agreements, supplying logs and diagnostic evidence, and following cases through to agreed response and resolution times.</li> <li>Take part in technical recovery during major incidents and in blameless post-incident reviews, feed recurring issues back to the engineering teams as clear requirements, share the follow-the-sun on-call roster, and keep incident tickets, operational procedures and runbooks accurate and current so that others can execute them successfully.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><span regions.</li> </ul> <p><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="FIR Body List" title: Social & Community Director, Esquire
description: <p><em>We are the UK's leading premium publisher, home to iconic and influential media brands including Esquire, Men's &amp; Women's Health, ELLE, Good Housekeeping, Harper's Bazaar, Digital Spy, Cosmopolitan, Red and more. At Hearst UK, we don't just create content – we shape culture.</em></p> <p><em>Our workplace is driven by passion, shaped by authenticity and powered by creativity. We back bold ideas, act with an entrepreneurial mindset and continually evolve to meet the moment – while respecting the legacy that's brought us here. We believe in each other's potential and push boundaries together to create meaningful impact, both across the media landscape and in people's lives.</em></p> <p><em>We're proud of our heritage – but even more excited about making history.</em></p> <p><em>Hearst UK operates an in-office policy with flexible Fridays. Our office is based at <strong>House of Hearst, 30 Panton Street, St James's, London, SW1Y 4AJ</strong>, where teams collaborate in person and connect across brands and functions.</em></p> <p><strong>Salary – £50,000–£60,000</strong><br>Salary is dependent on experience and will be assessed in line with the candidate's skills, knowledge and relevant expertise.</p> <h2>The Role...</h2> <p>As Social &amp; Community Director, you will own the success and growth of Esquire’s social platforms, with a particular focus on Instagram and TikTok. You will set the social strategy and editorial direction, translating Esquire’s wider editorial priorities into distinctive, high-performing, platform-native content that grows, engages and builds a lasting relationship with its audience.</p> <p>Working closely with editors, contributors and creative talent, you will bring Esquire’s editorial pillars to life across social, developing compelling formats and franchises that give audiences a reason to return. You will also play a key role in growing the commercial value of Esquire’s social channels, strengthening their place within the wider brand ecosystem.</p> <p>This is a highly visible editorial role. You will be a host and voice for Esquire, fronting social formats and video content and representing the brand with audiences, partners and at key cultural, brand and membership events.</p> <p>You will also help shape and grow Esquire’s new membership communities, hosting events, contributing to newsletters and working closely with the audience team to engage, nurture and build an active and connected community.</p> <h2>Main Duties...</h2> <ul> <li>Set Esquire’s social strategy across Instagram and TikTok, in line with the brand and wider editorial plans. Define clear audience priorities, content pillars and measures of success, adapting the approach as platforms, behaviours and audience habits evolve.</li> <li>Grow Esquire’s following and engagement in ways that build meaningful, lasting audience relationships. Use analytics, social listening and audience feedback to understand what is working, decide what to make next and continually improve performance.</li> <li>Develop distinctive social formats and franchises that give audiences a reason to return, including video fronted by Esquire’s editorial team. Host and present interviews, cultural coverage and original content, while helping other Esquire talent develop a natural and engaging voice on camera.</li> <li>Work closely with editors, writers, photographers, filmmakers, producers and contributors to commission and deliver distinctive, platform-native work. Set clear creative briefs and maintain high editorial and visual standards.</li> <li>Be hands-on in the filming and editing of social video content created by the editorial team, overseeing production and helping to develop regular, recognisable social franchises.</li> <li>Work closely with the commercial team to turn Esquire’s social reach, influence and expertise into valuable commercial opportunities. Develop partnership ideas that feel right for the brand and its audience, and contribute to pitches and presentations.</li> <li>Make Esquire’s social channels a valuable part of the wider brand ecosystem, strengthening the connections between social, editorial, partnerships, events and membership and increasing the commercial value of the channels.</li> <li>Work across editorial, digital and commercial teams to coordinate coverage, maximise major cultural and brand moments and ensure social is embedded within Esquire’s wider plans.</li> <li>Conceive, host and support events that bring Esquire’s audience together. Work with editorial and commercial colleagues to shape the right experiences, host or moderate conversations and extend their value through social coverage.</li> <li>Represent Esquire at selected partner, industry and audience events, acting as a highly visible ambassador for the brand and protecting the trust audiences place in Esquire by upholding its editorial and brand standards.</li> <li>Set direction and priorities for colleagues and contributors working across social. Coach on-camera talent, build a strong and reliable network of contributors and work with the hubbed Social Media Executive to support Facebook targets.</li> <li>Oversee social publishing, including captions, accessibility, permissions and rights. Manage time, production resources and delegated budgets against agreed priorities, escalating significant financial, legal, reputational or brand issues early.</li> </ul> <h2>What We Are Looking For...</h2> <h3>Essential</h3> <ul> <li>Significant proven experience setting and delivering social strategy, with a strong track record of growing audiences, increasing engagement and improving performance.</li> <li>Expert knowledge of Instagram, TikTok and Facebook, including how platform behaviour and audience habits evolve, with strong experience using analytics and insight to shape content and community strategy.</li> <li>Proven experience creating social content for luxury, lifestyle or media brands, with experience working with luxury brands on commercial activity.</li> <li>Strong editorial judgement and a natural instinct for turning culture, fashion, film, music, art and the wider cultural conversation into distinctive, engaging social content.</li> <li>Experience developing social-first formats and franchises, with the ability to identify what audiences want and turn ideas into high-performing content.</li> <li>The confidence and ability to lead work across multiple teams, set clear creative and editorial standards, influence senior stakeholders and help on-camera contributors develop their confidence and skills.</li> <li>Proven experience developing commercial partnership ideas and growing the commercial value of social channels, while protecting editorial independence, audience trust and clear disclosure.</li> <li>Experience directing social-first production and working closely with editorial, video and creative teams.</li> <li>Confidence and credibility as a presenter, with experience hosting interviews, video formats, live conversations or other audience-facing content.</li> <li>Excellent writing, communication and presentation skills, with strong judgement when handling sensitive editorial, audience or reputational issues.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable</h3> <ul> <li>Filming and editing skills, including Adobe Premiere Pro.</li> </ul> <h2>Benefits</h2> <p>Your benefits at Hearst UK are more than just extras – they are tools to help you thrive in every part of life.</p> <h3>Hearst Exclusives – Only for You!</h3> <ul> <li>Get adventurous with Good Housekeeping Taste and Beauty Testing Panels – yes, you could be trying the next big thing in beauty, food and drink.</li> <li>Snag luxe beauty steals at our legendary office sample sales – score big on top brands without breaking the bank!</li> </ul> <h3>Inclusion, Health &amp; Wellbeing&nbsp;–&nbsp;Feel Your Best</h3> <ul> <li>Stay healthy with Specsavers eye care, a company-funded Health Cash Plan and access to mental health support.</li> <li>Get active and stress-free with discounted gym memberships and the Cycle to Work scheme.</li> <li>Embrace flexibility with Location Flex and Holiday Exchange to take time when you need it.</li> <li>Take time to give back with a Charity Day and access wellbeing resources whenever you need them.</li> <li>Join one of our Hearst ERG groups.</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Wellness – Boost Your Budget</h3> <ul> <li>Plan ahead with a generous Workplace Pension, Income Protection, Life Assurance and Season Ticket Loan for easier commuting.</li> <li>Make smarter money moves using Salary Finance tools, Financial Wellbeing sessions and Home Tech benefits to spread costs.</li> <li>Treat yourself with major discounts across London plus everyday savings via the HAPI at Hearst app.</li> </ul> <h2>Inclusion &amp; Belonging</h2> <p>Hearst UK is deeply committed to using our influential brands to reflect the world we want to live in – one that respects, protects, represents and uplifts the voices and opinions of all people. As a business, we recognise the significant benefits of creativity, collaboration and innovation that come with diverse teams. Not only is diversifying the voices in our organisation the right thing to do, but it also helps us create powerful and exciting content that can be enjoyed by many more people. This is why we're working to build a sense of true belonging within our business and foster a culture in which everyone feels heard.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>COMPANY OVERVIEW</strong></p> <p>KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.</p></div><p><strong>TEAM OVERVIEW</strong></p> <p>KKR’s Public Policy &amp; Affairs (PPA) function is responsible for shaping and executing the firm’s global public policy, regulatory, and external engagement strategy. The team includes regional policy teams across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific. PPA plays a critical role in protecting and enhancing KKR’s “license to operate” by:</p> <ul> <li>Anticipating regulatory and geopolitical developments</li> <li>Advising investment teams on policy-related risks and opportunities</li> <li>Supporting portfolio companies in navigating complex stakeholder environments</li> <li>Engaging with governments, regulators, and industry bodies</li> </ul> <p>The team operates at the intersection of investing, policy, and reputation directly contributing to investment outcomes and long-term value creation.</p> <p><strong>POSITION SUMMARY</strong></p> <p>KKR is seeking an Principal to join its EMEA Public Policy &amp; Affairs team, based in London and working directly with &nbsp;the Head of EMEA Public Policy &amp; Affairs.</p> <p>This opportunity is for a public policy and affairs professional who combines strategic judgement with strong execution capabilities. Working closely with the Head of EMEA Public Policy &amp; Affairs, you will play a key role in translating the firm’s strategic priorities into concrete action and ensuring that political and regulatory insights inform investment decisions and portfolio company strategies. The role requires someone who can operate independently, manage complex and competing priorities, coordinate effectively across investment teams and internal stakeholders, and drive initiatives from analysis through execution.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></p> <ul> <li>Monitor and assess legislative, regulatory and geopolitical developments across EMEA, identifying emerging risks and opportunities for KKR and its portfolio companies.</li> <li>Develop a forward-looking perspective on policy and geopolitical trends, translating complex developments into actionable insights for investment teams and senior leadership.</li> <li>Partner with investment teams to integrate policy and geopolitical considerations into investment theses, due diligence and decision-making, including assessments of regulatory, political, reputational and stakeholder risks.</li> <li>Lead the preparation and coordination of senior executive and C-suite engagements, including high-quality briefings, strategic messaging and follow-up.</li> <li>Support portfolio companies on regulatory positioning, government relations and market-specific policy challenges.</li> <li>Develop and execute targeted stakeholder engagement strategies across priority EMEA markets, including through relevant industry associations and trade bodies.</li> <li>Support initiatives that reinforce KKR's reputation as a provider of trusted, long-term capital.</li> <li>Contribute to EMEA Public Policy &amp; Affairs thought leadership, internal strategic initiatives and fundraising activities.</li> <li>Over time, take ownership of key EMEA Public Policy &amp; Affairs workstreams, driving priorities from strategic analysis through to execution.</li> </ul> <p><strong>REQUIREMENTS</strong></p> <ul> <li>At least six years of relevant experience in public policy, government affairs, consulting, financial services or a related field.</li> <li>Strong understanding of EMEA political, regulatory and geopolitical dynamics, ideally with experience across multiple jurisdictions and firsthand exposure to policymaking processes.</li> <li>Experience working in a global organisation, with familiarity with both European and US policy environments.</li> <li>Sound commercial judgement and an understanding of how political and regulatory developments affect investment decisions, portfolio performance and business strategy.</li> <li>Ability to anticipate emerging policy risks and opportunities, connect complex developments to commercial priorities and formulate actionable recommendations.</li> <li>Proven ability to independently manage complex workstreams, balance competing priorities and deliver high-quality outcomes in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesise complex information into clear, concise and decision-oriented insights.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare executive-level briefings and strategic materials.</li> <li>Credibility, judgement and confidence to work effectively with senior leadership, investment professionals and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Strong collaborative skills and the ability to navigate a global, matrixed organisation.</li> <li>Proactive, intellectually curious and comfortable operating at both strategic and operational levels, with a hands-on approach to execution.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-ONSITE</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>KKR is an equal opportunity employer.&nbsp; Individuals seeking employment are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other category protected by applicable law.</p> <p>KKR will provide reasonable accommodations as required by applicable federal, state, and/or local laws. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About us</h2> <div><strong>Re-architecting Engineering for the Age of Intelligence<br></strong><br>PhysicsX is the physics AI company for industrials. The company’s mission is to accelerate hardware innovation by overhauling what industrial engineering and manufacturing look like today. PhysicsX is building a new simulation software stack to deliver deep physics AI enablement across the entire engineering lifecycle. The company partners with leading organisations in aerospace &amp; defence, automotive, semiconductors, materials, and energy &amp; renewables, supporting them on some of their most critical and complex challenges. PhysicsX is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with offices in London, New York, and Singapore and an expanding presence in the Bay Area.</div></div><h3><strong>Note: </strong>We are currently recruiting for multiple levels and positions, however please only apply for the role that best aligns with your skillset and career goals.</h3> <h2><strong>What you will do&nbsp;</strong></h2> <ul> translate physics and engineering challenges into mathematical problem formulations.</li> <li>Build models to predict the behaviour of physical systems using state-of-the-art machine learning and deep learning techniques.</li> <li>Discuss the results and implications of your work with colleagues and customers, especially how these results can address real-world problems.</li> <li>Collaborate with colleagues beyond the research team to translate your models into production-ready code.</li> <li>Communicate your work to others internally and externally as called for in paper publication venues, industry workshops, customer conversations, etc. This will involve writing for academic and non-academic audiences.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>What you bring to the table</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Ability to scope and effectively deliver projects.</li> <li>Enthusiasm about using machine learning, especially deep learning and/or probabilistic methods, for science and engineering.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to analyse issues, identify causes, and recommend solutions quickly.</li> <li>Excellent collaboration and communication skills — mesh-structured data;</li> <li>generative models for geometry and spatiotemporal data (VAEs, Diffusion Models, Bayesian non-parametric, scaling to large datasets, etc.).</li> </ol> </li> <li>Ideally, title: Senior Manager, Paid Social
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes&nbsp; and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.&nbsp; Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.&nbsp;</li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6"><u data-renderer-mark="true">THE ROLE </u></span></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2301" data-local-id="6d5afd27-5970-45c1-b675-f5df64663cbf"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6"><strong>Senior Manager, Paid Social</strong></span></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2320" data-local-id="f6597815-fb6f-48c2-a22a-55ab8b3f15f3"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">We are seeking a <strong>Senior Manager, Paid Social</strong></span>&nbsp;<em data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">to join our growing team.&nbsp;</span></em></p> <p>Paid social is one of the main ways Quince finds new customers, and this role sits at the centre of it. As Senior Manager, Growth Marketing (Paid Social), you will own strategy, execution and optimisation across Meta and other social platforms for a set of Quince departments, turning business goals into efficient media investment and steady, scalable growth.</p> <p>This is a hands-on, analytical role. You will manage significant media budgets against clear efficiency targets (ROAS, CAC and NC MTA ROAS), work out what is really driving performance, and work closely with creative, merchandising and analytics colleagues so that targeting and creative keep getting better. The role is critical to scaling our paid social acquisition engine.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2663" data-local-id="e0c03b8d-8a8f-42ae-b3e9-26b5a2308ae6"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">Responsibilities</span></strong></p> <p><strong>Paid social strategy and investment</strong> (the main focus of the role)</p> <ul> <li>Own paid social strategy and delivery for selected Quince departments across Meta, TikTok and emerging social channels.</li> <li>Manage and optimise significant paid media budgets to meet customer acquisition and efficiency targets.</li> <li>Monitor performance across campaigns, audiences and creative, and act quickly on what you find.</li> <li>Run a continuous programme of testing across audience segmentation, creative formats, messaging, bidding and budget allocation.</li> <li>Scale the campaigns that work, and deal with underperformance promptly.</li> <li>Adjust spend quickly in response to performance signals and changing product priorities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Performance analysis and optimisation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Analyse campaign results across different attribution frameworks.</li> <li>Identify what drives incremental customer acquisition and revenue growth, and turn those findings into practical campaign and creative decisions.</li> <li>Build and maintain dashboards, reporting frameworks and performance analyses.</li> <li>Work with our analytics team to improve the accuracy of measurement and attribution.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Creative and testing collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work closely with the Creative, Studio and Production teams to shape creative that performs.</li> <li>Develop ways of working that make sure creative suits each platform.</li> <li>Keep testing volume high enough to support growth targets, with a steady supply of new creative.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-functional collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work with Merchandising and Product to agree priority categories and launches.</li> <li>Partner with Analytics and Data on attribution and measurement.</li> <li>Present performance insights and growth opportunities to leadership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Growth experimentation and channel development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Find opportunities to expand into new paid social surfaces and formats.</li> <li>Test new growth approaches, including audience expansion, creator-led ads and performance creative formats.</li> <li>Keep improving our testing frameworks so we can run more experiments and learn more from each one.</li> </ul> <h3>What success looks like</h3> <p>In this role, you will:</p> <ul> <li>manage and optimise significant paid social spend for your departments against clear targets for ROAS, CAC and NC MTA ROAS;</li> <li>drive scalable customer acquisition through testing, experimentation and analysis;</li> <li>find new audience, creative and bidding opportunities that unlock incremental growth;</li> <li>build a high-performing creative pipeline in partnership with the creative teams;</li> <li>use data and attribution models to guide budget allocation and channel strategy; and</li> <li>respond quickly, and sensibly, to what the numbers are telling you.</li> </ul> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2753" data-local-id="9ae6a13b-2175-4a37-a4c2-5839b2f592ae"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">Qualifications </span></strong><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">Required:</span></strong></p> <ul class="ak-ul" data-local-id="44b79526-866b-4532-bc9f-9b66d6c2ce5e" data-indent-level="1"> <li> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2898" data-local-id="50ebe553-8026-457e-9d55-0014ff96596c">six or more years of experience in performance marketing or paid social growth;</p> </li> <li> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2898" data-local-id="50ebe553-8026-457e-9d55-0014ff96596c">deep experience managing Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) at scale, with real ROAS and CPA pressure;</p> </li> <li> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2898" data-local-id="50ebe553-8026-457e-9d55-0014ff96596c">experience managing TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube and other paid social channels;</p> </li> <li> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2898" data-local-id="50ebe553-8026-457e-9d55-0014ff96596c">strong analytical skills, with experience of attribution models and performance data;</p> </li> <li> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2898" data-local-id="50ebe553-8026-457e-9d55-0014ff96596c">a proven record of managing and optimising large paid media budgets;</p> </li> <li> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2898" data-local-id="50ebe553-8026-457e-9d55-0014ff96596c">experience of running performance creative tests and working closely with creative teams;</p> </li> <li> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2898" data-local-id="50ebe553-8026-457e-9d55-0014ff96596c">a data-led mindset, together with strong operational discipline; and&nbsp;comfort working in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.</p> </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p data-renderer-start-pos="3319"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><u data-renderer-mark="true">WHY Your Role

We are looking for a Mid/Senior AI Cinematic Video Editor who is deeply embedded in generative video workflows and can independently craft high-quality, narrative-driven content from concept to final output.

You are a sharp-eyed video editor comfortable operating at the intersection of creativity and emerging technology, building visually compelling long-form videos using AI-first pipelines. You take ownership of the entire production stack — from prompting and generation to editing, compositing, graphic design work and final delivery. You thrive in a high-performance environment where your quick wits and passion for story-telling shine.

Reporting to your Content Lead, this is what you'll be doing:


Key Responsibilities

  • Conceptualise scripts based on current production needs and centred around existing AI characters (our own IPs)

  • Create narrative-driven, longform video content, including stylized and explicit NSFW visuals, with a strong focus on storytelling, atmosphere, and visual coherence throughout
