We design, build, and run high-quality software solutions, combining strong engineering expertise, modern technologies, AI-enabled approaches, and proven delivery practices. Our teams work across Java, .NET, PHP, mobile, and web development, helping clients modernize their technology landscapes, improve their software capabilities, and build solutions that are reliable, scalable, and ready for the future.

We are fully dedicated to long-term partnerships, working as one organization with our customers and taking ownership from the first idea through to reliable execution and smooth operation. With nearshore delivery centers across Europe, we bring together experienced engineering and delivery teams who combine technical excellence, business understanding, and a strong sense of ownership.

People, engineering excellence, and strong client relationships are at the heart of what we do.

 

The opportunity

We are looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial Senior Technical Sales Manager to drive new business for CREATEQ with full revenue responsibility. In this role, you will win new clients, shape their entry into AI-driven software engineering, and turn it into long-term engineering engagements delivered by our teams.

Many companies still develop software the traditional way, mostly on Java and .NET. They want to benefit from AI-driven development but lack the know-how, processes, and capacity to do so. This is where you come in: you understand the client's starting point, develop the right approach together with them – from assessment and proof of concept to dedicated nearshore teams – and close the deal.

You will work closely with management, Business Development, and our engineering leads, and you will be the face of CREATEQ to CIOs, CTOs, and Heads of Engineering in Switzerland [and the DACH region].

 

What you'll do

  • Build and close your own pipeline with mid-sized and large companies in Switzerland [and the DACH region].
  • Assess clients' development processes, technology stacks, and AI maturity, and run workshops with engineering teams, IT leadership, and executive management.
  • Develop solution concepts and proposals – from assessment and proof of concept to dedicated nearshore engineering teams.
  • Lead commercial negotiations through to contract signature.
  • Grow existing client relationships and secure follow-on business.
  • Work closely with our engineering leads on team set-up, project kick-off, and quality assurance.
  • Track pipeline, order intake, and revenue against agreed targets and report on progress to management.

 

What we're looking for

This is a senior role with clear revenue responsibility. We are looking for someone who has successfully sold IT services before, brings a strong network in the Swiss market, and is equally credible in conversations with developers and with executive management.

Requirements

  • At least 8 years of experience selling IT services, software engineering, or nearshore/offshore capacity, including several years with personal revenue responsibility.
  • A proven track record in acquiring new clients and closing multi-year service engagements.
  • A strong network among CIOs, CTOs, and Heads of Engineering in the Swiss market.
  • A technical background (computer science, business informatics, or equivalent practical experience) with a solid understanding of Java and/or .NET environments and modern engineering practices (CI/CD, automated testing, DevOps).
  • A solid understanding of AI-driven software development (AI coding assistants, agentic development tools) and a realistic view of its benefits and limitations.
  • An entrepreneurial, closing-oriented mindset and the ability to work independently.
  • Native/Fluent German and excellent written and spoken English.
  • Swiss or EU citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit.

Benefits

  • A key role with direct impact on CREATEQ's growth.
  • An offering that is high on clients' agendas: AI-driven software engineering, delivered by experienced engineering teams.
  • A compensation package with a fixed salary and a performance-based component.
  • Direct collaboration with management and short decision paths.
  • Freedom to shape the role, bring your ideas, and make a visible impact.
  • A long-term perspective in an international software engineering company with a strong presence in the European market.

Haupt-Aufgaben

  • Unterstützung des Account Managers bei der Umsetzung von Kundenprojekten

  • Beratung von Kunden und technischen Partnern bei der Implementierung und Konfiguration von PrivaSphere Secure Messaging

  • Wahrung der Kundeninteressen im internen Entwicklungsprozess

  • Mithilfe beim Testprozess für neue Komponenten

  • Unterstützung und Dokumentation von Produkten und Dienstleistungen

  • Interner Support (Technik und Betrieb)

Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in ähnlichem Umfeld

  • Flair für Security, Datenschutz, Open Source und gutes Verständnis für Internet Technologien

  • Sehr gute PC-Anwenderkenntnisse im Umgang mit Betriebssystemen und Programmen, insbesondere MS Produkte (Anwendung und Konfiguration)

  • Verständnis von Linux und SQL-DB als zusätzlicher Vorteil und Entwicklungsmöglichkeit

  • Gute schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikation in Deutsch, Italienisch und Englisch (Französisch als zusätzlicher Vorteil)

Ergreifen Sie die Chance die digitale Transformation mit unserem dynamischen und motiviertem Team, welches wirklich Spass a der Arbeit hat, zu gestalten. Wir arbeiten in flachen Hierarchien, Sie haben also viel Potenzial Neues zu lernen, sich aktiv einzubringen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

raw.description:
About the BIIE

The Botnar Institute of Immune Engineering (BIIE) is an independent Swiss research institute advancing immune engineering to improve the health of children and adolescents, especially in low- and middle-income countries. The Institute brings together expertise across immunology, bioengineering, computational biology and artificial intelligence, combining fundamental research with a focus on translating scientific discoveries into practical and accessible health solutions. Established through the initiative of Fondation Botnar, the BIIE is a young and growing international research institute based in the Basel region.

Position Overview

We are seeking a creative, proactive and versatile Communications Officer to help bring the research, people and mission of the BIIE to a wide range of audiences.

Reporting to the Head of Communications & Institute Relations, and working closely with scientific and administrative colleagues across the institute, you will help translate complex scientific topics and lead the planning and execution of a broad range of communications activities.

This is a hands-on role, covering digital communications, content creation, internal communications, events and the production of institutional materials. You will take responsibility for content management on the BIIE's website and the Institute’s LinkedIn channel, and the organisation of internal and external events.

Key Responsibilities

Content Creation

  • Develop, write, edit and design engaging content for different audiences and channels, including news articles, press releases, newsletters, presentations, flyers and institutional materials.
  • Work with scientists and colleagues across the Institute as well as partner organisations to identify compelling stories and translate complex scientific topics into clear, accessible content.
  • Coordinate the production of visual and multimedia content, including photography, video and graphics.

Website & Social Media

  • Further develop and manage the day-to-day content of the BIIE website, ensuring it remains accurate, engaging and up to date.
  • Plan and coordinate digital content through an editorial calendar, proactively identifying opportunities for storytelling.
  • Monitor digital performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

Internal Communications

  • Develop and maintain effective internal communications channels to keep employees informed, connected and engaged.
  • Create and coordinate internal news, announcements and other communications materials.
  • Support all-staff meetings and other internal activities that strengthen the BIIE community and foster a shared institutional identity.

Stakeholder Engagement & Events

  • Support media relations activities, including media enquiries, press materials, media lists and monitoring.
  • Support stakeholder engagement activities, coordinating visits and meetings, and maintaining institutional contacts in a dedicated CRM.
  • Plan and coordinate internal and external BIIE events, including scientific events, stakeholder events, visits and institutional activities.
  • Manage event logistics and communications, including invitations, programmes, briefings, promotional materials and follow-up activities.

Communications Strategy & General Support

  • Support the Head of Communications & Institute Relations in establishing and implementing the BIIE's Communications and Institute relation Strategy and related priorities.
  • Ensure consistent application of the BIIE's key messages, tone of voice and visual identity across communications activities and materials.
  • Support the planning, coordination and implementation of communications projects and campaigns across the Institute.

Required Qualifications

Essential

  • University degree in communications, journalism, or a related field.
  • At least 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in communications, science communication, journalism or a related role.
  • Excellent writing and editing skills in English and German.
  • Experience creating and managing content in particular for digital channels.
  • Ability to understand complex scientific topics and translate them into accurate, accessible and engaging content for wider audiences.
  • Strong organisational and project management skills.
  • Ability and confidence to work directly with leading scientists and subject-matter experts.
  • A proactive, collaborative and hands-on working style, with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic and growing organisation.

Preferred

  • Background or professional experience in academia, life sciences, pharma, biotechnology, global health or another field relevant to the BIIE.
  • Experience with website content management systems and digital analytics.
  • Experience with visual communications and design tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud or Canva.
  • Experience producing or commissioning photography, video or other multimedia content.
  • Additional languages apart from English and German.
  • Experience working in an international and multicultural environment.

title: Operative Leitung mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen 80 - 100 %
description: Sie wollen nicht nur Zahlen verwalten, sondern mitdenken, gestalten und sich in eine verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe entwickeln? Die 2022 gegründete curadmin AG mit Sitz in Rotkreuz ist ein administratives Dienstleistungsunternehmen für Organisationen im ambulanten Gesundheitswesen. Im Zentrum stehen betriebswirtschaftliche Dienstleistungen, aktuell insbesondere für die Hauptkundin solicare AG. Wir sind beauftragt, eine ambitionierte Persönlichkeit als Operative Leitung mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen anzusprechen. In dieser vielseitigen Funktion bearbeiten Sie anspruchsvolle Finanzthemen, erstellen Reportings, Budgets und Forecasts und schaffen fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Geschäftsleitung und Verwaltungsrat. Sie koordinieren und entwickeln Dienstleistungen in den Bereichen Finanz- und Lohnbuchhaltung, HR, ICT und Governance weiter. Je nach Erfahrung bearbeiten oder koordinieren Sie zusätzlich Marketing- und Salesaufgaben. Sie sorgen für effiziente Prozesse, klare Abstimmungen, eine hohe Dienstleistungsqualität und die bedarfsgerechte Auslastung des Teams. Sie denken Prozesse digital und automatisieren, wo es sinnvoll ist. Sie verfügen über einen Hochschulabschluss in Betriebswirtschaft mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und bringen Erfahrung im Finanz- und Rechnungswesen, Controlling oder in der betriebswirtschaftlichen Beratung mit. Sie erfassen Zusammenhänge rasch, ziehen aus Zahlen die richtigen Schlüsse und vermitteln komplexe Inhalte verständlich. Erste Führungserfahrung ist von Vorteil, jedoch keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend sind Ihre Eigeninitiative, Lernbereitschaft und der Wille, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und etwas zu bewegen. Die Position bietet Ihnen die Chance, Ihre Stärken einzubringen, mit der Aufgabe zu wachsen und sich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Bei entsprechendem Leistungsausweis eröffnen sich weitere Karrieremöglichkeiten innerhalb der Unternehmung. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung. Kontakt: Corinne Häggi, Nathalie Ramel JÖRG LIENERT AG ZUG Neugasse 14 CH-6300 Zug Telefon 041 766 20 50 Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

description: <p><span data-teams="true">The Medical Affairs Project Associate Specialist (post-grad trainee) will join the International Medical TTR team and report to International Medical Strategy &amp; Operations. The post-grad trainee will support the planning, governance and execution of the international Medical Affairs Strategy for ATTR-CM across Alnylam's international markets, working closely with regional and country Medical teams and cross-functional partners. The role contributes to medical operations and planning deliverables, evidence generation portfolio, scientific engagement and insight programs, field medical excellence initiatives and patient experience work and offers first-hand insight into how a regional Medical Affairs organization is run. The scope is intentionally flexible: the more capability, initiative and curiosity the post-grad trainee brings, the more the remit can expand, in line with results.</span></p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the International Medical Strategy &amp; Operations team in planning, tracking and reporting on International Medical TTR strategic priorities and operating-model deliverables across international markets</li> <li>Help with the preparation of management materials, such as leadership updates, pre-reads, meeting materials and executive presentations, turning complex information into clear, decision-ready outputs</li> <li>Support medical planning and budget cycles by consolidating regional and country inputs, tracking spend against plan and preparing summaries, in partnership with Finance</li> <li>Contribute to evidence generation portfolio management by maintaining study trackers (e.g., investigator-initiated studies, research collaborations) and partnering with in preparing status, milestone and timeline overviews</li> <li>Support scientific engagement and medical education activities, including the speaker engagement process and congress planning, all scientific and non-promotional in nature</li> <li>Contribute to the TOP 41 Centers of Excellence (CoE) program, supporting the project owner in engagement mapping; this is a potential area where the post-grad trainee may take ownership of project deliverables, depending on experience and interest</li> <li>Support field medical excellence initiatives, such as field medical KPIs and dashboards, the quarterly medical insights process, training roll-out</li> <li>Contribute to patient experience work, including patient advocacy and engagement and patient support programs</li> <li>Gain first-hand insight into the regional medical leadership agenda by supporting cross-functional planning, governance meetings and operational follow-up</li> <li>Depending on experience and interest, support projects on AI-enabled tools, CRM and insights platforms, and other emerging medical priorities</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Availability for a minimum of 9 months; 12 months is strongly preferred</li> <li>Completed bachelor's degree; a master's degree is a plus</li> <li>Academic background in life sciences, medicine, pharmacy, biomedical sciences, public health or another analytical discipline is preferred; interest in Medical Affairs, cardiology or rare diseases is valued</li> <li>Strong logical and analytical thinking, with the ability to navigate complexity and structure ambiguous problems</li> <li>Ability to read, interpret and critically summarize scientific and clinical literature</li> <li>Awareness of, or willingness to learn, the compliance principles that govern Medical Affairs</li> <li>Advance PowerPoint and Excel skills; confidence using Microsoft Copilot and AI-enabled productivity tools is highly valued</li> <li>Fast learner, proactive and adaptive, taking ownership of high-quality outputs and handling confidential information with discretion</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus</li> <li>Flexibility to work 2-3 days per week in the Zug office; occasional travel possible (mainly EU)</li> <li>Collaborative, flexible and comfortable working in a fast-moving, cross-functional and international environment</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>The opportunity to join a highly motivated, science-driven team in a leading RNAi therapeutics company&nbsp;</li> <li>Hands-on exposure to how International Medical Affairs supports the AMVUTTRA ATTR-CM launch, with a focus on science, evidence and patients&nbsp;</li> <li>The chance to contribute to Alnylam's mission of bringing groundbreaking medicines to patients&nbsp;</li> <li>Direct one-to-one mentoring, supportive supervision, and regular development feedback&nbsp;</li> <li>Collaboration with a diverse team of experts across medicine, scientific engagement, evidence generation, patient experience, and analytics&nbsp;</li> <li>A strong office community, with events and opportunities to connect with colleagues across functions and disciplines&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>About Alnylam: </strong>Alnylam Pharmaceuticals (Nasdaq: ALNY) has led the translation of RNA interference (RNAi) into a whole new class of innovative medicines with the potential to transform the lives of people afflicted with rare and more prevalent diseases. Based on Nobel Prize-winning science, RNAi therapeutics represent a powerful, clinically validated approach to treating diseases at their genetic source by “interfering” with mRNA that cause or contribute to disease. Since our founding in 2002, Alnylam has led the RNAi Revolution and continues to turn scientific possibility into reality.</p> <p><strong>Our culture:</strong>&nbsp;Our people-first culture is guided by our core values: fiercely innovative, open culture, purposeful urgency, passion for excellence, and commitment to people, and these values influence how we work and the business decisions we make. Thanks to feedback from our employees over the years, we’ve been fortunate to be named a top employer around the world. Alnylam is extremely proud to have been recognized as one of Science Magazine’s Top Biopharma Employers, one of America's Most Responsible Companies for 2024 by Newsweek, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in Canada, France, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, and UK – among others.</p> <p>At Alnylam, we commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal employment opportunity. We are dedicated to building an environment where employees can feel that they belong, can bring their authentic selves to work, and achieve to their full potential. By empowering employees to embrace their unique differences at work, our business grows stronger with advanced and original thinking, allowing us to bring groundbreaking medicines to patients.</p> <p>Before applying, please review Alnylam's ⁠Candidate&nbsp;<a href="https://alnylampolicies.com/">Privacy Notice</a>&nbsp;regarding how Alnylam handles Personal Data you provide with your application for employment.</p> <p>#LI-CC1&nbsp;#LI-Hybrid</p> Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine  – Data Infrastructure
description: The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness. In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines : turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes. This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on. What you'll do Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence. Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it. Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims. Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation over change data feeds, where each update is a diff of what changed and every job is idempotent and resumable, so the graph converges to the same state however runs interleave, fail or replay, and readers only ever see committed, consistent versions. Measure precision and completeness: labeled evals for extraction and resolution, per-source coverage and correctness metrics, and lineage that pinpoints which source or stage broke and why. What we're looking for You've built and operated large-scale distributed data pipelines in production over petabytes of structured and unstructured data, with Spark over a lakehouse format (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi). You understand incremental processing deeply: change data capture, idempotent writes, backfills and reprocessing. Strong in Python and at least one systems language; you can read and tune Spark query plans. You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale. Bonus Entity resolution, record linkage, knowledge graphs or ontologies Information extraction or truth discovery at scale Lance or other columnar/vector-native formats Example projects Take a new billion-row dataset from first delivery to queryable entities in days, not months. Keep a graph of hundreds of billions of claims current with incremental updates, so a fact that changes on the web reaches it in minutes. Build a system that knows every company and person in the world, with one evidence-backed record each, resolved across the web and every source we ingest. Exa is an equal opportunity employer. raw.description:
We are seeking three experienced French-speaking SAP Analytics professionals to strengthen the internal SAP Finance/Analytics team of a public-sector client in Lausanne. The team supports the client’s financial reporting, budget planning, annual accounts and budget publication, all running on an SAP S/4HANA, BW / BW-IP, HANA and BusinessObjects landscape.

The three positions cover the full application lifecycle: one keeps the existing reporting and planning chains running, one builds enhancements and new developments, and one defines the target analytics architecture and guides the team through complex projects. All three work together within the same team, so you will have regular contact with colleagues across RUN, BUILD and architecture.

Location: Lausanne (minimum 3 days/week on-site during the first 3 months for onboarding and knowledge transfer, then remote. Remote work is possible only from Switzerland or the French border zone.

Contract: 01.01.2027 - 31.12.2029, renewable annually

Language: Fluent French

The Positions:

  1. SAP Analytics Techno-Functional Consultant – Corrective & Adaptive Maintenance (RUN) | approx. 100%

  • Qualify and analyse incidents on BW/IP, BO/Lumira, SLT, CDS/HANA Views and output management, including impact analysis

  • Reproduce issues and analyse data, performance, SLT replication and XML generation

  • Deliver corrections and changes across BW/IP, BO, Lumira, CDS/HANA, SLT and the custom ABAP XML program, with regression testing

  • Provide daily support for financial and budget reporting, as well as the production of annual accounts and budget publication

  • Deploy changes, support go-lives, carry out root cause analysis, and drive optimisation and documentation

2. SAP Analytics Techno-Functional Consultant – Enhancements & New Developments | approx. 60%

  • Analyse financial, budget and social reporting needs and map CRM/S4, BW, SLT and output management flows

  • Design BW/IP, HANA, CDS, BO/Lumira and SLT solutions and estimate effort and risks

  • Run POCs on analytical models, SLT and XML output flows

  • Build BW/IP models, CDS/HANA Views, BO/Lumira reports, SLT flows and the ABAP XML program, including testing

  • Prepare environments, transports and go-lives, and hand over to the support team

3. SAP Analytics Expert – Evolutive Maintenance & New Developments (mini-projects) | approx. 45%

  • Define the target analytics architecture (BW/IP, HANA, CDS, BO/Lumira, SLT) in line with the SAP roadmap and cloud analytics solutions

  • Lead scoping and GAP analysis, and deliver documented recommendations backed by SAP references and SWOT analysis

  • Lead POCs and validate performance and reporting output

  • Conduct design reviews, performance analysis and optimisation

  • Support the team on complex developments and knowledge transfer

Your Profile (all positions):

  • Senior-level SAP Analytics / BI experience on S/4HANA (for the Expert position: expert level, with proven experience in leading analytics architecture and design)

  • Strong BW / BW-IP skills in design, modelling, data loading, financial reporting and budget planning

  • Hands-on experience with financial reporting tools: AfO, BEx Analyzer, BEx Query Designer, WAD and broadcasting

  • Experience in budget planning, including planning models, simulations, consolidation and reporting

  • Solid knowledge of SAP BusinessObjects, Lumira and migration to WebI (N4V for WebI is a plus)

  • Experience with SAP SLT (CRM → S/4HANA replication, monitoring and troubleshooting)

  • Experience designing, extending and optimising CDS Views and HANA Views

  • ABAP skills to maintain and enhance a custom program generating XML for output management

  • Understanding of integration across CRM, S/4HANA, BW, HANA and reporting tools, with a focus on data quality, performance, security and governance

  • Knowledge of management accounting (controlling) and project management

  • Familiarity with RUN processes: incident resolution, SPS/SP cycles, regression testing, transports and Basis validation

  • Experience with Jira, ChaRM, Solution Manager and Confluence

  • Knowledge of SAP cloud analytics solutions (and, for the Expert position, the SAP analytics roadmap)

  • SAP Analytics certifications (BW, BW-IP, CDS Views, SLT, BO, Lumira, SAP cloud analytics) are an advantage

  • Fluent French is essential

What We Offer:

  • A long-term engagement through 2029, renewable annually

  • Meaningful work supporting the financial and budget processes of a public-sector organisation

  • A broad and modern SAP Analytics landscape covering BW/IP, HANA, CDS, SLT, BO/Lumira and cloud analytics

  • A choice of focus (RUN, BUILD or architecture) to suit your expertise and availability

  • Collaboration within an experienced internal SAP Finance / Analytics team

  • Remote working after the onboarding phase

  • Opportunities to shape the client’s analytics architecture and future roadmap

title: Senior IT & Cybersecurity Auditor
description: We are currently looking for an experienced Senior IT & Cybersecurity Auditor to join an international financial services environment and contribute to strengthening its technology, cybersecurity and risk management landscape. In this role, you will combine your technical expertise with a strong understanding of governance, risk and controls. You will take ownership of complex audit engagements, challenge existing practices and provide independent insights that support informed decision-making at senior management level. This is an excellent opportunity for a technically experienced professional who enjoys investigating complex IT environments, identifying potential vulnerabilities and making a meaningful impact on the organisation’s security and resilience. Responsibilities & Tasks Plan, lead and deliver comprehensive IT audit engagements based on a risk-oriented approach, including the development of audit strategies and testing procedures. Review and evaluate technology-related risk areas, including cybersecurity, IT governance, infrastructure, network security, access management, data protection, operational resilience and emerging technologies. Apply your technical background to analyse complex IT architectures, identify potential weaknesses and assess the effectiveness of existing security measures and internal controls. Review findings from penetration tests, vulnerability scans, security assessments and monitoring activities, translating technical observations into relevant risk insights. Assess emerging technologies, particularly Artificial Intelligence and AI-driven solutions, and evaluate their implications for cybersecurity, governance and technology risk. Present audit findings, recommendations and risk assessments to relevant stakeholders, including senior management and executive-level decision-makers. Prepare structured and impactful audit documentation, ensuring that identified issues are clearly communicated and actionable. Track remediation activities and evaluate the effectiveness of implemented measures. Work closely with colleagues across IT, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, Governance and Business functions to promote continuous improvement and strengthen the overall control environment. Requirements & Qualifications Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a comparable discipline, alternatively equivalent professional experience. At least 10 years of relevant professional experience in IT, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Technology Risk or a related technical field. Strong practical knowledge of several core technology and security domains, such as Network Security, Identity and Access Management, Vulnerability Management, Security Operations or IT Resilience. Experience working with technical security assessments, penetration testing results, vulnerability scanning solutions or comparable security tools. Previous exposure to IT Audit, Internal Audit, External Audit, Technology Risk or another assurance-related function is highly desirable. Professional certifications such as CISA, CISM, CISSP or equivalent qualifications are considered an advantage. Interest in Artificial Intelligence, machine learning and AI-driven technologies, particularly in relation to security, governance and risk management. Practical experience in AI governance or AI-based solutions is beneficial. Strong analytical capabilities, a structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to assess complex technical information independently. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge established practices constructively and engage with senior decision-makers. High professional integrity, sound judgement and a strong sense of responsibility. Fluent English is required. German and/or French language skills are an additional advantage. Willingness to undertake international business travel, approximately 20 days or more annually. Benefits & Culture Work in an international financial services environment where technology, security and risk management play a central role. Take on a highly visible position with direct exposure to senior stakeholders and strategic decision-making. Enjoy a broad and varied scope of responsibility across technology, cybersecurity and emerging risk areas. Collaborate with experienced professionals from IT, Business, Risk and Governance in a supportive and knowledge-driven environment. Benefit from opportunities for continuous professional development, specialist training and relevant industry certifications. Contribute to meaningful initiatives that strengthen organisational security, resilience and governance. Please submit your application directly via <a href="https://careers.hilti.group/de-ch/stellenangebote/19051-en/global-trainee-program-outperformer-software-business-track-m-f-x/">Hilti Careerpage</a></div> <h2>Construction technology is being reinvented. Be part of it.</h2> <p>Construction is one of the world's largest industries, and one of its least digitized. That is changing fast. At Hilti, we are not only developing software products - we are building and growing digital businesses around them. Hilti is at the centre of that shift, with a growing portfolio of software products that connect jobsites, offices, teams, and tools across the entire construction lifecycle. We are looking for ambitious, internationally mobile early-career talents with a global mindset who are excited about technology but see their future in business and leadership rather than in a purely technical software career.<br><br>The Software &amp; Digital Business Track of Hilti's Outperformer Program is a two-year accelerated development program that prepares you for a commercial, international leadership career in our software and digital businesses. You will learn how technology becomes customer value, how software businesses grow, how products are brought to market, and how commercial decisions are made. This is not a rotation program where you shadow senior leaders. From day one, you carry real responsibility.</p> <h2>What You'll do</h2> <p>The Software Track is designed to build the next generation of software business leaders at Hilti – Business Owners, Business Directors, Segment Managers and ultimately Senior Management Team members. If you want a structured path to running a business, this program is built for that outcome.<br><br>The program places you inside one of two business units:<br><br>Construction Software: Home to Fieldwire (Field Software for project and workforce management), ON!Track (asset management), and 4PS (construction business management). You will work directly with customers, product teams, and business leadership across Europe and beyond.<br><br>Fastening &amp; Protection Solutions: Where design &amp; engineering software for structural connections (e.g. PROFIS Engineering Suite), MEP supports and passive fire protection systems are developed and brought to market across a global customer base of structural and mechanical engineers.<br><br><br>For the Construction Software business unit, the program is structured to provide a balanced foundation in customer and market exposure, software product understanding, and business experience, while giving you the opportunity to work with at least two software products during the program:</p> <ul> <li>​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month sales assignment, developing direct customer insight and understanding the business challenges addressed by our software solutions.</li> <li>​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each across product and business teams, including exposure to an international project.</li> </ul> <p>​For the Fastening &amp; Protection Solution business unit, the program provides exposure to product management , software development, exposure to customers and start-ups and international project experience:</p> <ul> <li>​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month product management assignment, building product understanding and market insight.</li> <li>​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each, involving international projects that broaden your business perspective and global exposure.</li> </ul> <p>You will have a dedicated senior mentor from the start, direct exposure to executive leadership, and a peer cohort of Global Trainees across all Hilti business tracks globally.</p> <h2>What You’ll Bring</h2> <p>You are close to graduating or have recently completed a Master's degree - your degree is likely to be in construction management, civil engineering, or mechanical engineering with a focus on construction, Computer Science, or also Business study programs with an affinity for Software and construction. What matters more than your degree subject is the combination of traits below:</p> <ul> <li>Global mobility - you are willing and able to relocate internationally, multiple times. A global thinker who is keen for diverse cultural experiences.</li> <li>Digital and AI orientation - you think natively in digital workflows, comfortable with software tools, and know the power and potential of AI.</li> <li>Language - you are fluent in English and/or German, Dutch, French, Spanish or Italian. </li> <li>Commercial instinct - you are drawn to how businesses grow, how customers make decisions, and how products create.</li> <li>Low ego, high drive - you take the work seriously and yourself lightly. You seek feedback, move fast, and are energised by ambiguity rather than unsettled by it.</li> <li>You are at the start of your career and have maximum three years of junior work experience.</li> </ul> <h2>What’s In It for You</h2> <p>​​Show us what you can do, and in return, we promise you the experience of a lifetime. We offer you a transformative journey filled with learning, growth, and invaluable experiences that will shape your perspective and personal and professional development. On top of that, you’ll also take part in some fascinating courses and events:</p> <ul> <li>Introductory Global Summit: Experience 4 days at our global headquarters in Liechtenstein, featuring the presence of our Executive Board and Global Senior Leadership. The summit offers a comprehensive overview of our business, while fostering soft skill development and meaningful collaboration with fellow program participants.</li> <li>Social Project Summit: 7 days dedicated to building a better future, with contribution to a hands-on, high-impact community project. This experience offers the chance to immerse yourself in a different culture while actively improving living conditions for those in need.</li> <li>Leadership Summit: An enriching learning journey in partnership with a renowned business school, featuring online modules and collaborative projects with fellow program participants. The experience concludes with a 5-day on-campus summit to deepen insights and to foster business and leadership skills.</li> </ul> <h2>Why Hilti</h2> <p>Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.<br><br>Learn more about our recruitment process: https://careers.hilti.group/en/candidate-interview-preparation/</p> <h2>Commitment to Inclusion</h2> <p>​​At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.<br><br>​Exciting software journey: You will dive into the fast-paced world of our construction software business, gaining exposure to innovative digital solutions that are transforming one of the world's largest industries.<br>​<br>​Global cross-team collaboration: You will work with colleagues worldwide and get guidance from a dedicated mentor as you grow in your career.<br><br>​We hire for a career, not for a position. If you are looking for long-term career prospects and opportunities to grow, this is the perfect start.​<br><br>​Are you ready to jumpstart your career? Our hiring process is designed to help you showcase your skills and experience. The process has multiple steps and requires a longer period of time:</p> <ul> <li>It all starts with your application and a video interview.</li> <li>Get connected with our HR team in an online interview.</li> <li>Get ready to flex your problem-solving muscles with our online Business Case Round.</li> <li>Impress our Business Line Managers with your presentation skills and insights during the next round.</li> <li>And, if you make it to the end, you'll receive an invitation to our Assessment Center.</li> </ul> <p>​Exciting, right? Let's get started!</p> <p><strong>4PS is part of the Hilti Group</strong>, which gives our people access to international opportunities and development programs within the wider Hilti organization. This vacancy is part of Hilti’s Global Trainee Program. Interested in joining the program? Please submit your application directly via <a href="https://careers.hilti.group/de-ch/stellenangebote/19051-en/global-trainee-program-outperformer-software-business-track-m-f-x/">Hilti Careerpage</a>.<br><br>​The Assessment Center will take place in Liechtenstein at Hilti Headquarter on December 1st and 2nd, 2026. Applications will be reviewed in the order they’re received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible since there are limited spots for the Assessment Center!​<br><br>Learn more about our recruitment process:<br><a href="https://careers.hilti.group/en/candidate-interview-preparation/" target="_blank"><br>Candidate Interview Preparation</a></p> <p>​​For further questions, please feel free to contact Vanessa Furtner ----- and (My LinkedIn).<br>​<br>*For non-EU / EFTA citizens: Please state your eligibility status to work in EU or UK countries and note that if you do not own a valid work permit, Hilti cannot guarantee your final employment due to authority regulations.​</p> <section class="section-image js-animate"> <div class="container-fluid"> <div class="row"> <div class="col-md-6 col-lg-7"> <div class="slant-outer">&nbsp;</div> </div> </div> </div> </section> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

We are looking for a Mid/Senior AI Cinematic Video Editor who is deeply embedded in generative video workflows and can independently craft high-quality, narrative-driven content from concept to final output.

You are a sharp-eyed video editor comfortable operating at the intersection of creativity and emerging technology, building visually compelling long-form videos using AI-first pipelines. You take ownership of the entire production stack — from prompting and generation to editing, compositing, graphic design work and final delivery. You thrive in a high-performance environment where your quick wits and passion for story-telling shine.

Reporting to your Content Lead, this is what you'll be doing:


Key Responsibilities

  • Conceptualise scripts based on current production needs and centred around existing AI characters (our own IPs)

  • Create narrative-driven, longform video content, including stylized and explicit NSFW visuals, with a strong focus on storytelling, atmosphere, and visual coherence throughout

  • Own and manage end-to-end AI video production workflows, from ideation and prompting to generation, editing, and post-production

  • Utilise tools such as Kling, Seedance, Happy Horse and other AI video models/platforms to produce high-quality visual sequences

  • Develop and maintain consistent character appearance, style, and scene continuity across longer narratives using advanced techniques

  • Integrate motion graphic design and colour correction to deliver cohesive final outputs

  • Experiment rapidly with new AI models, tools, and techniques, incorporating them into production workflows and sharing skills with the rest of the team

  • Align with your Content Lead’s creative direction while maintaining a high degree of autonomy in execution and technical decision-making

  • Continuously refine workflows for efficiency, scalability, and output quality


Your Qualifications

Hard Skills

  • 4–6+ years of experience in video production, VFX, or digital art, with a strong portfolio (AI-driven video work is a must)

  • Hands-on experience with the latest AI video tools and models (e.g., Kling, Seedance, Happy Horse, and similar emerging options)

  • Solid understanding of AI image/video generation pipelines, including prompting, batching, consistency techniques, and post-processing

  • Experience with traditional tools like Premiere Pro, After Effects or similar for final assembly and polish

  • Strong grasp of visual storytelling, pacing, composition, and cinematic language

  • Ability to maintain character and scene consistency across sequences in AI-generated content


Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaboration skills (fluent in English)

🎯 High ownership — able to take ideas from concept to completion independently

⚡️ Experimental mindset — comfortable navigating ambiguity and evolving tools

⏱️ Fast iteration cycles — able to test, fail, refine, and improve quickly

🧠 Curious and self-driven — constantly exploring new AI capabilities and workflows

🧢 Open to feedback and continuous improvement

🍭 #NSFW — Comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit adult content


Bonus Points

  • Experience in AI-native storytelling or filmmaking

  • Background in 3D, VFX, technical art or as a colourist

  • Familiarity with training/customizing models (LoRAs, embeddings, fine-tuning)

  • Prior experience in adult, dating, or adjacent creative industries a huge bonus

  • Experience with ComfyUI

  • Experience with Stable Diffusion / AUTOMATIC1111 and related tooling (Advanced prompting, working with trained LoRAs, refining, upscaling, inpainting etc.)

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

  • South America • $28K – $58K

description: Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende IT-stage waarin je jouw technische kennis in de praktijk kunt brengen én jezelf verder kunt ontwikkelen? Bij Cefetra in Rotterdam hebben we vanaf februari 2027 een stageplek beschikbaar voor een enthousiaste en leergierige IT-student. wie zijn wij? Cefetra Group bestaat uit verschillende handelsbedrijven die actief zijn binnen de agrarische sector en de voedingsingrediëntenindustrie, waaronder toonaangevende merken binnen de ingrediëntenmarkt. Samen hebben we ongeveer 800 medewerkers, verspreid over 39 kantoren in 17 landen wereldwijd. We werken nauw met elkaar samen om onze klanten de best mogelijke service te bieden. Samen met onze leveranciers bouwen we sterke supply chains en creëren we waarde door grondstoffen in te kopen en te leveren aan de internationale voedingsmiddelen-, diervoedings- en energiesector. Bekijk hier onze corporate video . De stage Als IT Support Stagiair(e) word je onderdeel van het IT-team en ondersteun je collega’s bij hun dagelijkse IT-vragen. Wil jij AI-oplossingen ontwikkelen die direct bijdragen aan toegankelijke en toekomstbestendige zorg? Bij PharmaPartners werk je aan AivyCare: een nieuw, intelligent platform dat huisartsen en zorgorganisaties helpt om zorgvragen slimmer, sneller en beter af te handelen. Als AI Engineer bouw je mee aan toepassingen die de druk in de zorg verlagen en de continuïteit van zorg helpen borgen.

Je komt terecht in een omgeving waar nog veel te bouwen en te ontdekken is. Samen met onze huidige AI engineer / architect werk je aan de verdere ontwikkeling van AivyCare en help je technische keuzes te vertalen naar een schaalbaar en relevant product voor de zorg.

Wat ga je doen?

Als AI Engineer werk je in een klein en gedreven team aan de ontwikkeling van AivyCare. Je schakelt direct met engineering, architectuur, product en domeinkennis. Je bouwt niet alleen aan techniek, maar denkt ook mee over hoe we AI slim, veilig en schaalbaar toepassen in een product dat er echt toe doet.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het ontwerpen, bouwen en doorontwikkelen van AI-functionaliteiten binnen AivyCare.

  • Het ontwikkelen van backend services, API-koppelingen en intelligente workflows.

  • Het vertalen van ideeën en use cases naar werkende prototypes en productieklare oplossingen.

  • Het toepassen van LLM’s, agentic workflows en andere AI-technieken waar die aantoonbaar waarde toevoegen.

  • Het verbeteren van kwaliteit, testbaarheid, onderhoudbaarheid en schaalbaarheid.

  • Het meedenken over architectuurkeuzes, technische richting en ontwikkelstandaarden.

  • Het samen met onze AI engineer / architect versnellen van de ontwikkeling van AivyCare.


Wie zoeken wij?

Wij zoeken niet primair op senioriteit of een vast aantal jaren ervaring. Voor ons zijn mindset, eigenaarschap en het vermogen om mee te bouwen in een ondernemende omgeving belangrijker. Je werkt in een complexe en veranderende omgeving en houdt overzicht wanneer er veel tegelijk speelt. Je kijkt niet alleen naar wat vandaag nodig is, maar vooral naar wat morgen waarde levert: nieuwe marktontwikkelingen, innovatiekansen en de mogelijkheden van AI. Je neemt eigenaarschap over de volledige levenscyclus van je producten en je coacht collega’s in het vak. Je helpt het team om AI en agentic development verantwoord en effectief in te zetten binnen het ontwikkelproces.


Daarnaast vind jij het leuk om:

  • De behoeften van verschillende belanghebbenden, waaronder onze klanten en gebruikers, in kaart te brengen, documenteren en met elkaar in overeenstemming te brengen;

  • Eén of meer of meerdere scrum teams aan te sturen, die je begeleid in het ontwikkelproces volgens de SCRUM methodiek (planning, retrospective, refinements, e.d.);

  • De kwaliteit van de producten te waarborgen en continu te verbeteren door afstemming met de ontwikkelteams en alle betrokken stakeholders;

  • De schakel te zijn tussen klant en organisatie, waarbij je de klantwensen vertaalt naar concrete voorstellen en deze prioriteert op een product backlog;

  • AI in te zetten ter ondersteuning van bijvoorbeeld analyse, requirements, prototyping, documentatie en voorbereiding van refinements (natuurlijk zorg je ook voor een grondige controle, review en validatie op de output van AI;

  • De kwaliteit van producten bewaken en borgen dat deze voldoen aan de kwaliteits-, product- en informatiebeveiligingsnormen, in afstemming met ontwikkelteams en stakeholders;

  • De product backlog creëren, prioriteren en onderhouden, zodat het developmentteam aan de juiste ontwikkelingen werkt.

Werken met AI en agentic development

AI verandert de manier waarop software wordt ontwikkeld. Binnen PharmaPartners werken R&D-teams toe naar een gedeelde agentic way of working. De mens blijft verantwoordelijk voor keuzes en resultaten, terwijl AI ondersteunt bij onderdelen van het werk. Daarom zoeken we iemand die kansen ziet, kritisch blijft en nieuwe werkwijzen snel eigen maakt.

Heb je al ervaring met AI-tools, AI-agents, skills, prompten of agentic development? Dan is dat een duidelijke pré. Heb je die ervaring nog niet, maar ben je nieuwsgierig, leergierig en bereid je hierin actief onder te dompelen? Dan nodigen we je ook van harte uit om te reageren.

Waar kom je terecht?

Je werkt in een enthousiast Portfolio- en R&D-team en rapporteert aan de Teamlead Portfolio. Je levert een zichtbare bijdrage aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een van de grootste eHealth-platformen van Nederland en hebt als senior invloed op de koers van het product en de werkwijze van het team. Dat doe je samen met open, eerlijke, en behulpzame collega’s in een hechte en informele organisatie.


Herken jij je hierin?

  • Jij hebt minimaal HBO+ werk- en denkniveau in de richting van bedrijfskunde, IT, zorgtechnologie of iets soortgelijks;

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in de zorg-ICT, in een rol als business analist of product owner;

  • Jouw kennis van de Nederlandse taal zit op minimaal C2-niveau. Ook in het Engels kun jij je zowel mondeling als schriftelijk goed uitdrukken;

  • Ruime ervaring met business analysetechnieken en het documenteren van requirements, ook bij complexe vraagstukken;

  • Je hebt ervaring met het bijdragen aan productvisie en roadmap en met het prioriteren op basis van strategische doelen;

  • Je vindt het niet erg als jouw werkdag soms anders loopt, of buiten een vast 9 tot 5 patroon valt;

  • Je deelt gemakkelijk kennis (van de Nederlandse zorgmarkt) en informatie met anderen;

  • Je staat stevig in je schoenen, ook als de druk op je werk toeneemt en houdt altijd overzicht.

Je bent communicatief vaardig, ambitieus en gedisciplineerd. Je durft vragen te stellen, keuzes te onderbouwen en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, en je neemt anderen mee in je koers. Tegelijk werk je graag samen, sta je open voor feedback en heb je de nieuwsgierigheid en het lef om nieuwe technologie verantwoord toe te passen.

Klaar om samen met ons de koers van eHealth en softwareontwikkeling te bepalen?

Dan zoeken we jou!

En is dit wat je zoekt?

  • Een passend salaris: Voor deze vacature geldt een range van € 4.000 - € 5.500 bruto p/m op basis van een fulltime werkweek.

  • €500,- persoonlijk budget: Gebruik het voor een sportabonnement, of investeer in je eigen ontwikkeling.

  • 26 vakantiedagen en 8,33% vakantiegeld: Eventueel kun je zelfs nog 5 extra vakantiedagen erbij kopen (naar rato).

  • Beschikbare pensioenpremie: wij zijn aangesloten bij Allianz en bieden een premie met een eigen bijdrage van 4,8%.

  • Ruimte voor groei: Binnen PharmaPartners bieden wij diverse Talentenprogamma’s aan, die gericht zijn op persoonlijke ontwikkeling, het inzetten van jouw talent en kracht en een programma om erachter te komen of dat jij jezelf in een leidinggevende rol ziet!

  • Een hechte, open werksfeer: Ervaar een warme, open werkomgeving waar collega’s samen successen vieren. Binnen PharmaPartners zorgt de Brabantse gezelligheid voor een laagdrempelige benadering en een sterke teamspirit.

  • Leaseauto : Wij bieden jou een leaseregeling aan zodat jij met goed vervoer jouw klanten kunt bezoeken.

  • Uitdagende functie: Ga de uitdaging aan bij een organisatie die impact maakt in de samenleving in de zorgsector. Je draagt direct bij aan de maatschappij door te werken voor de zorg, waar jouw inzet het verschil maakt.

  • Sporten onder werktijd: Bij PharmaPartners moedigen we een gezonde levensstijl aan, inclusief sporten onder werktijd. Op dinsdag en donderdag heb je de mogelijkheid om samen met collega’s aan het eind van de dag te gaan sporten.

  • Hybride werken: Hybride werken bij ons betekent dat je twee keer per week op kantoor wordt verwacht, terwijl je de rest van de tijd de vrijheid hebt om vanuit huis te werken. Deze aanpak zorgt voor een balans van interactie en flexibiliteit.

  • Teamspirit: Versterk de teamgeest door deel te nemen aan diverse sportevenementen, zoals een tennistoernooi of de singelloop in Breda. Bouw samen met je collega's aan een hechter team.

description: Amsterdam (hybrid) | Part-time (freelance) 8 hours a week | €2,000 to €2,500 per month Foleon is a leading content creation platform providing business teams with a fast and scalable way to produce highly-engaging content experiences that bring a new level of intelligence to their customer journeys. Foleon is based in Amsterdam and New York and serves more than 1,200 global B2B brands. We value people who are bold, ambitious, collaborative, and customer-centric. Even better, the ones who know how to work hard and have fun at the same time. We’re a team of highly driven people, with a great sense of human connection and a clear focus. Your Mission As our Senior Product & AI Counsel, you’ll own the legal side of our product and AI proposition, working with us about one day a week on a retainer basis. It’s a new role. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering and leadership to make sure what we build and ship holds up under the EU AI Act, cybersecurity law, digital accessibility rules and GDPR. Your Job Act as our product counsel: join product syncs, review features before they’re built, and flag legal and compliance questions early. Make sure our platform, and the content our customers publish with it, meets the European Accessibility Act and related standards. Build privacy into the product by advising on GDPR questions tied to new features and data. Advise on cybersecurity law, including NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and incident reporting duties, working closely with our security team. Track changes in AI, cybersecurity, accessibility and privacy regulation, and turn them into practical guidance for the team. Your Competencies & Skills Senior and independent: you make calls and own them, without someone steering you. A practical communicator who explains complex regulation to product teams in plain language, with answers instead of memos full of caveats. Proactive and curious: you spot gaps before they become problems and want to understand how the product actually works. Comfortable working part-time and flexibly, and available when something urgent comes up. Your Qualifications A Master’s in Law (or equivalent) and 6+ years of experience, ideally a mix of law firm and in-house at a tech or SaaS company. Experience with cybersecurity law (NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act) and digital accessibility rules (European Accessibility Act). A solid grounding in commercial and corporate law, with working knowledge of employment law. GDPR and privacy expertise is a plus, ideally at DPO level or with a certification such as CIPP/E. title: Senior communicatieadviseur interne en corporate communicatie
description: Bouw jij mee aan de volgende fase van HeinenoordZicht Groep? Na een zeer recente fusie van twee bedrijven hebben we onze krachten gebundeld in HeinenoordZicht Groep, een wervelende speler in de assurantiebranche. Eén met ambitie en potentie. Eén die bouwt aan een gezamenlijke cultuur en gedeeld verhaal. Aan een organisatie waar collega's elkaar weten te vinden, waar strategische keuzes helder worden vertaald naar de praktijk en waar communicatie een belangrijke rol speelt in verbinding, verandering en groei. Hiervoor willen we ons team nu uitbreiden met een senior communicatieadviseur die moeiteloos schakelt tussen strategie en uitvoering. Iemand die ons mede richting geeft, beweging creëert, mensen weet mee te nemen in verandering en de communicatiestrategie vertaalt naar een concrete communicatieaanpak. Iets voor jou? De functie in het kort: Enerzijds ligt de nadruk op interne communicatie en het versterken van onze positie als werkgever. Je helpt collega’s begrijpen waar we als organisatie staan, waar we naartoe gaan en wat dit betekent voor hun werk. Je versterkt onze gezamenlijke identiteit en zorgt voor communicatie die helder, relevant en herkenbaar is. Tegelijkertijd bouw je mee aan onze positie op de arbeidsmarkt en aan een sterke candidate en employee experience. Je onderhoudt contacten met interne stakeholders en externe partijen en geeft zo binnen jouw aandachtsgebied mede vorm aan de corporate en directiecommunicatie over onze organisatie, strategie en het werkgeversmerk. Je levert ook bijdragen aan perscommunicatie, woordvoering en events en signaleert reputatierisico’s. Wat breng je mee? Je bent een strateeg én een creatieve doener. Je krijgt energie van grote, soms complexe communicatietrajecten. Staat op als eigenaar van het totaal: van eerste goed doordachte idee tot uitvoering en zichtbaar resultaat. Het is daarbij je tweede natuur om niet meteen in middelen te duiken. Je verdiept je altijd eerst in ‘de bedoeling’. Wat willen we bij wie bereiken en wat is daarvoor nodig? Je adviseert over de communicatieaanpak bij projecten, veranderingen en andere organisatieontwikkelingen. De rol van strategisch gesprekspartner voor managers en directie is dan ook ‘100% comfort zone’. En ook mooi: je krijgt de ruimte om zelf verdere vorm te geven aan je functie. Deze is namelijk nieuw en daarmee nog in beweging. Waar kom je te werken? Jouw werkplek vind je in ons splinternieuw en moderne hoofdkantoor in ’s-Hertogenbosch, dicht bij het Provinciehuis. Maar thuiswerken is ook helemaal onderdeel van onze cultuur. Samen met een communicatieadviseur ben je verantwoordelijk voor de interne, corporate en arbeidsmarktcommunicatie van HeinenoordZicht Groep. Je rapporteert aan de directeur HR & Communicatie en werkt nauw samen met de collega’s van MarCom, die zich richten op klantcommunicatie. De sfeer is informeel. Werken in jeans en op sneakers vinden we de normaalste zaak van de wereld. We geven je ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen vanuit je eigen expertise en werken vanuit vertrouwen en samenwerking. Zo maken we samen communicatie die helder, relevant en effectief is. Wat krijg je hiervoor terug? Een goed salaris: schaal loopt van € 5.000,- tot € 7.623,- bruto op basis van 40 uur per week. We stemmen de hoogte van je salaris af op je kennis en ervaring. Deelname aan de collectieve pensioenregeling bij BeFrank. Maandelijkse netto internetvergoeding van € 20,-. 27 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband en de mogelijkheid om jaarlijks maximaal 5 dagen bij te kopen. Reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,25 per kilometer tot 40 km enkele reis of volledige vergoeding bij reizen met het openbaar vervoer. Aantrekkelijke kortingen op je zorgverzekering en de eigen verzekeringsproducten van HZG. De mogelijkheid om een (elektrische) fiets te leasen tegen fiscaal voordelige voorwaarden. De flexibiliteit om deels vanuit huis te werken, waarbij ook gezorgd wordt voor een fijne en veilige thuiswerkplek. Werken bij een topspeler in de Nederlandse assurantiemarkt die onderdeel is van de stabiele, internationale NN Group. Blijvende aandacht voor jouw ontwikkeling en inzetbaarheid. Wanneer pas je goed in ons team? Als de liefde voor communicatie onderdeel is van je DNA: Je bent een energieke bruggenbouwer tussen vraag en antwoord, tussen vandaag en morgen. Je houdt van verandering en voortuitgang. Van dynamiek en groei. Als je ‘aan’ gaat van stakeholdermanagement: Je weet precies hoe je hen moet betrekken bij jouw projecten en zorgt voor een soepele communicatie. Als strategie en hands-on creatie twee delen van jouw geheel zijn: Innovatieve ideeën, creatieve concepten, aansprekende online en offline communicatiemiddelen, verbindende content: jij brengt het mee. Met een neusje voor visueel aantrekkelijke beelden en een hart voor het schrijven van heldere en doelgroepgerichte teksten. Als het maar inspireert en verbindt. Als je je organisatietalent ook wilt inzetten: Je hebt geen moeite met het organiseren van evenementen. Van concept tot uitvoering: jij hebt alles onder controle. Als op jouw kilometerteller behoorlijk wat interne communicatie staat: Jij bent de spil van onze interne communicatie. Door jouw inspanningen blijft iedereen binnen de HeinenoordZicht Groep goed geïnformeerd en betrokken. Je draagt zorg voor een levendig en informatief intranet, organiseert inspirerende interne bijeenkomsten en zorgt voor een consistente stroom van boeiende updates en nieuws. Arbeidsmarktcommunicatie is onderdeel van je rol. Heb je hier al ervaring mee? Mooi. Zo niet, dan verwachten we dat je je hierin verder ontwikkelt. Wat willen we sowieso terugzien op je cv? Minimaal een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in een relevante richting. Minimaal vijf jaar werkervaring in een soortgelijke functie. Heb je ervaring met PR, arbeidsmarkt- en/of corporate communicatie? Plusje! Wie zijn wij? Twee sterke bedrijven, Heinenoord Holding en Zicht, risico- en verzekeringsadviseurs, samengebracht in één toekomstgerichte organisatie: HeinenoordZicht Groep. Een nieuwe naam, gebouwd op meer dan een eeuw ervaring. De kracht van digitale mogelijkheden combineren we met lokaal ondernemerschap én de professionaliteit van een grote landelijke Nederlandse speler. En wat is ons DNA? Wij helpen elkaar en onze klanten vooruit. We geven onafhankelijk en professioneel advies en helpen bij het maken van bewuste keuzes, om slagvaardig te blijven bij financiële risico’s. Dit geldt zowel richting onze klanten, als binnen de organisatie. Dit is wat ons energie geeft en waar ons talent ligt. Dit doen wij vanuit ons vakmanschap, vanuit de wens om persoonlijk, als team én als organisatie te groeien, en vanuit de lokale verbinding. Dat is waarom onze collega’s hier werken, waarom onze klanten bij ons komen én blijven. En wat ons verbindt. We werken er zo iedere dag samen aan, om van HeinenoordZicht Groep steeds verder te laten groeien als GAAF bedrijf: Goed geregeld, Aantrekkelijk voor medewerkers, Aantrekkelijk voor klanten en Financieel gezond. Solliciteren? Enthousiast geworden over deze vacature van senior communicatieadviseur bij HeinenoordZicht Groep in Den Bosch? Reageer dan via de solliciteerbutton. We sluiten deze vacature als we een passende kandidaat hebben gevonden. Voor deze vacature werken wij niet samen met werving- en selectiebureaus. Een assessment kan onderdeel zijn van de procedure. Wil je als freelancer reageren? Heeft geen zin. We zoeken écht naar een vaste kracht. Voor meer informatie, mail ons op Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Customer Operations Director
raw.description:
Customer Operations Director 

Do you know how to combine customer focus, commercial awareness and operational excellence? 

 

As Customer Operations Director, you will lead our customer service, order management and sales support teams across our international Building Automation markets.

Your goal is to make sure customers and partners get fast, reliable and consistent service, from their first question to final delivery. 

This role is for a leader who sees the bigger picture and knows how to turn it into effective day-to-day operations. 

 

What will you do? 

You are responsible for the full customer journey after first contact. That covers answering customer questions and requests, processing orders, following up on quotes, and coordinating deliveries and service. You work closely with Sales, Technical Support, Supply Chain and Finance. 

 

You will: 

  • Lead and develop teams across multiple countries: set clear roles, coach team leaders, and manage capacity and service levels. 

  • Bring customer service, order management and sales support together into one way of working, with clear ownership and smooth handovers between teams and countries. 

  • Support Sales: handle incoming requests, follow up on quotes and orders, and keep customer data in the CRM accurate. Sales keeps ownership of accounts, pricing and targets. 

  • Set up a clear process for technical customer questions with our Technical Support team, from first response to escalation. 

  • Work with Supply Chain on product availability and delivery dates, and keep customers and Sales informed when issues come up. 

  • Simplify processes, reduce manual work, and standardize ways of working across countries while respecting local language and market needs. 

  • Work with IT to improve how teams use our CRM, order management system and customer portals. 

  • Use customer feedback and data to improve service, and share insights with Sales and Product. 

  • Lead the organization through change together with HR and country managers, while keeping service levels high. 

 

In addition: 

  • You have 10+ years of experience in customer service, order management and/or sales support in a B2B environment. 

  • You have 5+ years of leadership experience, including managing team leaders and being responsible for service performance. 

  • You have a proven track record of improving processes and leading change, ideally across multiple countries. 

  • You combine commercial awareness with operational discipline. 

  • You have experience with CRM and order management systems, and you know how to turn data into practical improvements. 

  • Experience in building automation, technical products or subscription services is a strong plus. 

  • You are fluent in Dutch and professionally proficient in English. German is a plus. 

  • You are willing to travel regularly between teams and markets. 

 

What you get   
In numbers  

  • A competitive salary based on your experience;  

  • We find a healthy work-life balance important: working flexible hours combined with 30 vacation days a year and the option to buy more;  

  • 8% holiday allowance;  

  • Travel allowance of € 0,23/km with a daily maximum of 150 kilometers.  

  

For your own sustainability  

  • Be secured with our pension plan;  

  • Feel engaged and join our participation plan; 

  • Keep on learning with your personal education possibilities and budget;  

  • Be happy and fit by using our healthy cafeteria, our free on-premises fitness where you can participate in CrossFit, Pilates and Spinning classes or play table tennis or table football. 

 

Ready to make an impact? 

Do you want to take Customer Operations within Building Automation to the next level and build a strong, scalable and customer-focused organization for our customers and partners? 

Then we would love to meet you. Apply for the position of Customer Operations Director and discover how you can make an impact at Priva.
